            color: var(--lime);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .geo-modal-text {
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .geo-modal-actions {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .btn-dark-secondary {
            height: 48px;
            background: #2A2D34;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 14px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .btn-lime-modal {
            height: 48px;
            background: var(--lime);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 14px;
            color: #121417;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            width: 100%;
        }

        /* ==================== 3. АКТИВНАЯ ПОЕЗДКА (ЗЕЛЕНАЯ/ЖЕЛТАЯ/КРАСНАЯ ПОДСВЕТКА) ==================== */
        .active-trip-screen {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: var(--bg-root);
            z-index: 200;
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: max(22px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px max(22px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
            border: 3.5px solid var(--green-glow);
            border-radius: 0;
            transition: border-color 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease;
        }
        .active-trip-screen.active { display: flex; }

        .active-trip-screen.glow-green {
            border-color: var(--green-glow);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 24px rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.14);
        }
        .active-trip-screen.glow-yellow {
            border-color: var(--yellow-glow);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 24px rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.16);
        }
        .active-trip-screen.glow-red {
            border-color: var(--red-glow);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 28px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.22);
        }

        .trip-top-block {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .trip-timer {
            font-size: 38px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }

        .trip-active-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--green-glow);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .trip-active-dot {
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--green-glow);
        }

        .sensor-pills-grid {
            width: 100%;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .sensor-pill {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-card);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 11px 14px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .sensor-pill svg {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .sensor-pill-text {
            font-size: 12.5px;
            line-height: 1.25;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .sensor-caption {
            font-size: 11.5px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        /* Центральная экономия во время поездки */
        .trip-center-block {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
            margin: auto 0;
        }

        .trip-center-label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .trip-live-savings {
            font-size: 64px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            letter-spacing: -1.5px;
            line-height: 1;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Нижний блок метрик и свайпа */
        .trip-bottom-block {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .trip-cards-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .trip-mini-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-card);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 14px 16px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .trip-mini-icon {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .trip-mini-val {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .trip-mini-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .smoothness-bar {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-card);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 16px 18px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .smoothness-label {
            font-size: 13.5px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .smoothness-val {
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Свайп для завершения */
        .swipe-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 58px;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-card);
            border-radius: 18px;
            padding: 5px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            overflow: hidden;
            cursor: pointer;
            touch-action: pan-y;
        }

        .swipe-track-text {
            width: 100%;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            pointer-events: none;
            padding-left: 36px;
        }

        .swipe-thumb {
            position: absolute;
            left: 5px;
            top: 5px;
            width: 48px;
            height: 46px;
            background: var(--lime);
            border-radius: 14px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #121417;
            cursor: grab;
            transition: transform 0.15s ease;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        .swipe-thumb.dragging {
            transition: none;
        }

        /* ==================== 4. ИТОГ ПОЕЗДКИ (ОНЛАЙН И БЕЗ ИНТЕРНЕТА) ==================== */
        .summary-modal-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(8, 9, 11, 0.85);
            z-index: 250;
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 16px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .summary-modal-overlay.active { display: flex; }

        .summary-card {
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--bg-modal);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            padding: 22px 18px 20px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
        }

        .summary-title {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        .trophy-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        .trophy-icon-box {
            width: 34px;
            height: 34px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: var(--lime-dim-bg);
            color: var(--lime);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .trophy-text {
            font-size: 13.5px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--lime);
        }

        .summary-big-amount {
            font-size: 46px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            letter-spacing: -1px;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .summary-sub-caption {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 1.4;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
        }

        /* Плашка "Связь отсутствует" */
        .offline-banner {
            width: 100%;
            background: #2A2D34;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 14px 16px;
            display: none;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
            text-align: left;
        }
        .offline-banner.visible { display: flex; }

        .offline-banner svg {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .offline-banner-title {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 3px;
        }

        .offline-banner-sub {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.35;
        }

        /* Сетка 6 карточек итога поездки */
        .stats-grid-6 {
            width: 100%;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
        }

        .stat-cell {
            background: var(--bg-cell);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 14px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 4px;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .stat-cell-val {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .stat-cell-label {
            font-size: 11.5px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        /* Стили ячейки ввода расхода по БК */
        .bk-input-card {
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--bg-cell, #2A2D34);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 12px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .bk-input-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary, #8C919B);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .bk-input-header svg {
            width: 16px;
            height: 16px;
            color: var(--lime, #D2FA58);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .bk-input-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .bk-input-field {
            flex: 1;
            height: 44px;
            background: #1C1E22;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            border-radius: 10px;
            color: #FFFFFF;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 0 12px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
            outline: none;
            transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
        }
        .bk-input-field:focus {
            border-color: var(--lime, #D2FA58);
        }
        .bk-input-field::placeholder {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .bk-unit-badge {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--lime, #D2FA58);
            background: rgba(210, 250, 88, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(210, 250, 88, 0.25);
            padding: 10px 12px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
    </style>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/app.css">
</head>
<body>

<div class="mobile-container">

    <!-- ==================== 1. ГЛАВНЫЙ ЭКРАН ==================== -->
    <div class="cockpit-scroll">
        <header class="top-header">
            <h1 class="brand-logo">autoXAK</h1>
            <button type="button" class="btn-auth-exit" onclick="logoutAndGoLogin()" aria-label="Выйти">
                <span>Выйти</span>
                <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4"/>
                    <polyline points="16 17 21 12 16 7"/>
                    <line x1="21" y1="12" x2="9" y2="12"/>
                </svg>
            </button>
        </header>

        <!-- Плашка автомобиля (связана с бэкендом и Гаражом) -->
        <a href="/setup" class="vehicle-banner" id="vehicle-banner-link">
            <span class="vehicle-banner-name" id="cockpit-car-name">Мой автомобиль</span>
            <span class="vehicle-banner-action">Изменить</span>
        </a>

        <!-- Карточка "Моя экономия" -->
        <div class="savings-card">
            <div class="savings-card-top">
                <span class="savings-card-title">Моя экономия</span>
                <svg class="wallet-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M20 12V8H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h12v4"/>
                    <path d="M4 6v12c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14v-4"/>
                    <path d="M18 12a2 2 0 0 0-2 2c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h4v-4h-4z"/>
                </svg>
            </div>
            <a href="/history" class="savings-amount-big" id="cockpit-savings-val">+0 ₽</a>
            <p class="progress-caption" id="savings-empty-caption">Экономия появится после поездки</p>
            <div class="savings-card-divider"></div>
            <a href="/history" class="savings-card-bottom">
                <span class="history-link-text">История поездок</span>
                <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <line x1="7" y1="17" x2="17" y2="7"/>
                    <polyline points="7 7 17 7 17 17"/>
                </svg>
            </a>
        </div>

        <section class="progress-card" id="cockpit-progress"><h2>Мой прогресс</h2>
            <div class="progress-values" style="display:none"><span class="progress-value"><span class="progress-number">—</span> <small>/ 100</small></span> <span class="progress-delta"></span></div>
            <p class="progress-empty">Недостаточно данных. Совершите поездку, чтобы увидеть прогресс.</p>
            <p class="progress-caption">Среднее за последние 7 дней</p></section>

        <!-- Модель сравнения -->
        <div class="info-card">
            <span class="info-card-label">Модель сравнения</span>
            <span class="info-card-val-text" id="cockpit-ghost-status">базовый лихач</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Поездок в базе -->
        <div class="info-card">
            <span class="info-card-label">Поездок в базе</span>
            <span class="info-card-val-big" id="cockpit-trips-count">0</span>
        </div>

        <button type="button" class="btn-lime-primary" onclick="requestStartTrip()">Начать поездку</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Нижняя панель навигации -->
    <nav class="bottom-tab-bar">
        <a href="/history" class="tab-item" aria-label="История поездок">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"/>
                <path d="M3 3v5h5"/>
                <path d="M12 7v5l4 2"/>
            </svg>
        </a>
        <a href="/" class="tab-item active" aria-label="Главный экран">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="M3 9.5L12 3l9 6.5V20a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6h-6v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V9.5z"/>
            </svg>
        </a>
        <a href="/setup" class="tab-item" aria-label="Мой автомобиль">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="M14 16H9m10 0h3v-3.15a1 1 0 0 0-.84-.99L16 11l-2.7-3.6a1 1 0 0 0-.8-.4H5.24a2 2 0 0 0-1.8 1.1l-.8 1.63A6 6 0 0 0 2 12.42V16h2"/>
                <circle cx="6.5" cy="16.5" r="2.5"/>
                <circle cx="16.5" cy="16.5" r="2.5"/>
            </svg>
        </a>
    </nav>

    <!-- ==================== 2. МОДАЛКА: ДОСТУП К ГЕОЛОКАЦИИ НЕ ВЫДАН ==================== -->
    <div class="modal-backdrop" id="modal-geo-denied">
        <div class="geo-modal-card">
            <div class="geo-icon-box">
                <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M21 10c0 7-9 13-9 13s-9-6-9-13a9 9 0 0 1 18 0z"/>
                    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/>
                </svg>
            </div>
            <div class="geo-modal-text">
                Доступ к местоположению нужен для точного измерения поездки и расчета результата
            </div>
            <div class="geo-modal-actions">
                <button type="button" class="btn-dark-secondary" onclick="closeGeoModals()">Закрыть</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn-lime-modal" onclick="retryGeoPermission()">Предоставить</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ==================== 3. МОДАЛКА: ГЕОЛОКАЦИЯ ВЫКЛЮЧЕНА ==================== -->
    <div class="modal-backdrop" id="modal-geo-disabled">
        <div class="geo-modal-card">
            <div class="geo-icon-box">
                <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M21 10c0 7-9 13-9 13s-9-6-9-13a9 9 0 0 1 18 0z"/>
                    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/>
                </svg>
            </div>
            <div class="geo-modal-text">
                Геолокация нужна для точного измерения поездки и расчета результата
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="btn-lime-modal" onclick="retryGeoPermission()">Как включить геолокацию</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ==================== 4. ЭКРАН АКТИВНОЙ ПОЕЗДКИ ==================== -->
    <div class="active-trip-screen glow-green" id="active-trip-screen">
        <div class="trip-top-block">
            <div class="trip-timer" id="trip-timer-display">00:00</div>
            <div class="trip-active-badge">
                <span class="trip-active-dot"></span>
                <span>Поездка активна</span>
            </div>

            <div class="sensor-pills-grid">
                <div class="sensor-pill">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <path d="M5 12.55a11 11 0 0 1 14.08 0"/>
                        <path d="M1.42 9a16 16 0 0 1 21.16 0"/>
                        <path d="M8.53 16.11a6 6 0 0 1 6.95 0"/>
                        <line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12.01" y2="20"/>
                    </svg>
                    <div class="sensor-pill-text" id="pill-net-status">Интернет<br>подключен</div>
                </div>
                <div class="sensor-pill">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <path d="M21 10c0 7-9 13-9 13s-9-6-9-13a9 9 0 0 1 18 0z"/>
                        <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/>
                    </svg>
                    <div class="sensor-pill-text" id="pill-gps-status">GPS<br>подключен</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="sensor-caption">Влияет на точность итога</div>
        </div>

        <div class="trip-center-block">
            <div class="trip-center-label">Расчетная экономия</div>
            <div class="trip-live-savings" id="trip-live-savings">+0 ₽</div>
        </div>

        <div class="trip-bottom-block">
            <div class="trip-cards-row">
                <div class="trip-mini-card">
                    <svg class="trip-mini-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <circle cx="6" cy="19" r="3"/>
                        <path d="M9 19h8.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0-7h-11a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0-7H15"/>
                        <circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"/>
                    </svg>
                    <div class="trip-mini-val" id="trip-live-distance">0 км</div>
                    <div class="trip-mini-label">Дистанция</div>
                </div>
                <div class="trip-mini-card">
                    <svg class="trip-mini-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12"/>
                    </svg>
                    <div class="trip-mini-val" id="trip-live-bumps">0</div>
                    <div class="trip-mini-label">Неровности</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="smoothness-bar">
                <span class="smoothness-label">Индекс плавности</span>
                <span class="smoothness-val" id="trip-live-smooth">100/100</span>
            </div>

            <!-- Свайп для завершения -->
            <div class="swipe-container" id="swipe-container">
                <div class="swipe-thumb" id="swipe-thumb">
                    <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/>
                        <polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19"/>
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div class="swipe-track-text">Свайп для завершения</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ==================== 5. ИТОГ ПОЕЗДКИ (ОНЛАЙН И ОФФЛАЙН) ==================== -->
    <div class="summary-modal-overlay" id="summary-modal">
        <div class="summary-card">
            <div class="summary-title">Итог поездки</div>

            <div class="trophy-badge">
                <div class="trophy-icon-box">
                    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <path d="M6 9H4.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0-5H6"/>
                        <path d="M18 9h1.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 0-5H18"/>
                        <path d="M4 22h16"/>
                        <path d="M10 14.66V17c0 .55-.47.98-.97 1.21C7.85 18.75 7 20.24 7 22"/>
                        <path d="M14 14.66V17c0 .55.47.98.97 1.21C16.15 18.75 17 20.24 17 22"/>
                        <path d="M18 2H6v7a6 6 0 0 0 12 0V2Z"/>
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <span class="trophy-text">Выгода сохранена</span>
            </div>

            <div class="summary-big-amount" id="sum-savings-rub">+0.00 ₽</div>
            <div class="summary-sub-caption">
                Сэкономлено на топливе<br>относительно лихача
            </div>

            <!-- Баннер отсутствия связи (показывается при оффлайне) -->
            <div class="offline-banner" id="sum-offline-banner">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/>
                    <path d="M16.72 11.06A10.94 10.94 0 0 1 19 12.55"/>
                    <path d="M5 12.55a10.94 10.94 0 0 1 5.17-2.39"/>
                    <path d="M10.71 5.05A16 16 0 0 1 22.58 9"/>
                    <path d="M1.42 9a15.91 15.91 0 0 1 4.7-2.88"/>
                    <path d="M8.53 16.11a6 6 0 0 1 6.95 0"/>
                    <line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12.01" y2="20"/>
                </svg>
                <div>
                    <div class="offline-banner-title">Связь отсутствует</div>
                    <div class="offline-banner-sub">Поездка синхронизируется при появлении сети</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 6 карточек статистики поездки -->
            <div class="stats-grid-6">
                <div class="stat-cell">
                    <span class="stat-cell-val" id="sum-starts">0</span>
                    <span class="stat-cell-label">Резкие старты</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-cell">
                    <span class="stat-cell-val" id="sum-brakes">0</span>
                    <span class="stat-cell-label">Резкие торможения</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-cell">
                    <span class="stat-cell-val" id="sum-idle">0 мин</span>
                    <span class="stat-cell-label">Время в пробках</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-cell">
                    <span class="stat-cell-val" id="sum-bumps">0</span>
                    <span class="stat-cell-label">Неровности</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-cell">
                    <span class="stat-cell-val" id="sum-distance">0 км</span>
                    <span class="stat-cell-label">Дистанция</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-cell">
                    <span class="stat-cell-val" id="sum-duration">0 ч 00 мин</span>
                    <span class="stat-cell-label">Время поездки</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="smoothness-bar"><span class="smoothness-label">Индекс плавности</span><span class="smoothness-val" id="sum-smooth">— / 100</span></div>

            <button type="button" class="btn-lime-primary" onclick="claimToPiggyBank()" style="margin-top: 0;">
                Зачислить в копилку
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>

<script>
    let currentUserId = localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_user_id') || '';
    let currentCarId = localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_selected_car_id') || 'haval_jolion_15t_4wd';
    let currentCityFuelRate = Number(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_fuel_pass')) || (['haval_jolion_15t','haval_jolion_15t_4wd','haval_jolion_15t_fwd'].includes(currentCarId)?8.5:null);
    let tripActive = false;
    let tripStartTime = 0;
    let lastTickMs = 0;
    let tripTimerInterval = null;
    let telemetryStream = [];
    let wakeLock = null;
    let activeSessionId = null;
    let draftTimerInterval = null;
    let lastGpsFixMs = 0;
    let startingTrip = false;
    let gpsSamples = [], motionSamples = [];
    let captureGeoPermission = 'unknown', captureMotionPermission = 'unknown';
    let saveActiveDraft = null, draftSaveChain = Promise.resolve();
    let pendingFinishedPayload = null, finishingTrip = false;
    let releaseRecordingLock = null;
    let estimateController = null, lastEstimateRequestMs = 0;
    let recordingOwnerId = null, recordingCarId = null;

    async function updateLiveEstimate() {
        if (!tripActive || estimateController || !navigator.onLine || telemetryStream.length < 50) return;
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastEstimateRequestMs < 15000 || now - lastGpsFixMs > 5000) return;
        const firstGps = telemetryStream.findIndex(point=>point.lat!==null && point.lon!==null);
        if (firstGps<0) return;
        const usable = telemetryStream.slice(firstGps);
        if (usable.length<50 || usable.filter(point=>point.lat!==null && point.lon!==null).length / usable.length < 0.9) return;
        if (usable.some((point,i)=>i && point.t-usable[i-1].t>2)) return;
        lastEstimateRequestMs = now;
        const sessionId = activeSessionId;
        const stride = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((usable.length-1)/5999));
        const samples = usable.filter((_,i)=>i%stride===0);
        if ((usable.length-1)%stride) samples.push(usable[usable.length-1]);
        const controller = new AbortController();
        estimateController = controller;
        try {
            const {response, data:result} = await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON('/api/v1/telemetry/preview', {
                method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json', ...AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders()},
                body:JSON.stringify({session_id:sessionId,user_id:recordingOwnerId,car_id:recordingCarId,
                    telemetry_stream:samples,sampling_stride:stride}), signal:controller.signal
            },8000);
            if (!response.ok) return;
            if (!tripActive || activeSessionId!==sessionId || result.session_id!==sessionId
                || result.status!=='PREVIEW') return;
            document.getElementById('trip-live-savings').innerText = Number.isFinite(result.cost_savings_rub) ? `${result.cost_savings_rub>=0?'+':''}${result.cost_savings_rub.toFixed(2)} ₽` : '—';
            document.getElementById('trip-live-smooth').textContent = Number.isFinite(result.smooth_score)?`${result.smooth_score}/100`:'—';
            document.getElementById('trip-live-savings').title = Number.isFinite(result.cost_savings_rub)?'Расчётная оценка относительно базового лихача':'Укажите городской расход в гараже и дождитесь данных датчиков.';
        } catch (_) {
            if (tripActive && activeSessionId===sessionId) document.getElementById('trip-live-savings').title = 'Обновление расчёта после восстановления связи.';
        } finally {
            if (estimateController===controller) estimateController=null;
        }
    }

    function rawRecording(endReason = 'user') {
        const end=Math.max(Date.now(), tripStartTime, gpsSamples[gpsSamples.length-1]?.timestamp_ms || 0, motionSamples[motionSamples.length-1]?.timestamp_ms || 0);
        return {
            started_at_ms: tripStartTime,
            ended_at_ms: Math.min(end,tripStartTime+86400000),
            gps: [...gpsSamples], motion: [...motionSamples], end_reason: end>tripStartTime+86400000?'duration_limit':endReason,
            permissions: {motion: captureMotionPermission, geolocation: captureGeoPermission},
            device: {app_version:'2.0.0', user_agent:navigator.userAgent.slice(0,1000)}
        };
    }

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (tripActive && document.hidden && saveActiveDraft) saveActiveDraft();
        if (tripActive && !document.hidden && 'wakeLock' in navigator && (!wakeLock || wakeLock.released)) {
            const sessionId=activeSessionId;
            navigator.wakeLock.request('screen').then(lock=>{if(tripActive && activeSessionId===sessionId) wakeLock=lock; else lock.release();}).catch(()=>{});
        }
    });
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => {if (tripActive && saveActiveDraft) saveActiveDraft();});

    // Реальные координаты и скорость GPS
    let currentSpeedMps = 0.0;
    let currentLat = null;
    let currentLon = null;
    let prevGpsLat = null;
    let prevGpsLon = null;
    let prevGpsTimeMs = null;
    let previousNativeSpeedMps = null;

    // Живые счетчики поездки
    let liveDistanceKm = 0.0;
    let liveBumpsCount = 0;
    let liveHarshStarts = 0;
    let liveHarshBrakes = 0;
    let lastBumpTime = 0;
    let lastEventTime = 0;

    // Экспоненциальный фильтр вектора гравитации (EMA LPF) для защиты от наклона телефона в держателе
    let gravX = 0.0, gravY = 0.0, gravZ = 9.81;
    let gravInitialized = false;
    let lastMotionMs = 0, shockFiltered = 0, shockArmed = true, shockQuietSince = 0;

    let motionHandler = null;
    let geoWatchId = null;

    const CAR_NAMES_FALLBACK = {
        "haval_jolion_15t_4wd": "Haval Jolion 1.5T 4WD",
        "haval_jolion_15t_fwd": "Haval Jolion 1.5T 2WD",
        "haval_jolion_15t": "Haval Jolion 1.5T 4WD",
        "skoda_octavia_16mpi_mt": "Skoda Octavia 1.6 MPI",
        "skoda_octavia_14tsi_dsg": "Skoda Octavia 1.4 TSI",
        "skoda_octavia_14tsi": "Skoda Octavia 1.4 TSI",
        "skoda_octavia_20tsi_dsg_4wd": "Skoda Octavia 2.0 TSI 4x4",
        "geely_coolray_15t_fwd": "Geely Coolray 1.5T",
        "geely_coolray_15t": "Geely Coolray 1.5T",
        "lada_vesta_16_mt": "LADA Vesta NG 1.6",
        "lada_vesta_18_cvt": "LADA Vesta NG 1.8",
        "chery_tiggo_7pro_16t_awd": "Chery Tiggo 7 Pro Max"
    };

    function haversineKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
        const toRad = (d) => (d * Math.PI) / 180.0;
        const R = 6371.0;
        const dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1);
        const dLon = toRad(lon2 - lon1);
        const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
        return 2 * R * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - a)));
    }

    function formatCockpitSavings(val) {
        const num = Number(val);
        if (isNaN(num)) return "+0.0 ₽";
        const str = (Math.round(num * 100) % 10 === 0) ? num.toFixed(1) : num.toFixed(2);
        return `${num>=0?'+':''}${num===0?'0':str} ₽`;
    }

    function formatDistance(km) {
        const value=Math.max(0,Number(km)||0);
        return value>0 && value<1 ? `${Math.round(value*1000)} м` : `${value.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'')} км`;
    }

    function formatDurationHoursMins(totalSec) {
        const sec = Math.max(0, Number(totalSec) || 0);
        const hrs = Math.floor(sec / 3600);
        const mins = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60);
        return `${hrs} ч ${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')} мин`;
    }

    async function resolveCarDisplayName(carId) {
        const savedName = localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_selected_car_name') || localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_car_name');
        if (savedName && savedName.trim().length > 0 && !savedName.includes('undefined')) {
            return savedName.trim();
        }
        try {
            const {response:res, data} = await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON('/api/v1/vehicles/catalog');
            if (res.ok) {
                const items = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.catalog || []);
                for (const item of items) {
                    if (item.id === carId) {
                        const cleanTitle = (item.full_name || `${item.make || ''} ${item.model || ''} ${item.trim || ''}`).replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/g, '').trim();
                        return cleanTitle || item.id;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_) {}
        return CAR_NAMES_FALLBACK[carId] || "Мой автомобиль";
    }

    let cockpitSync = null;
    function syncCockpitWithBackend() {
        if (!cockpitSync) cockpitSync=refreshCockpit().finally(()=>{cockpitSync=null;});
        return cockpitSync;
    }
    async function refreshCockpit() {
        const owner=AutoXAKSession.getUserId();
        if (!owner) return;
        await AutoXAKSession.syncPendingProfile();
        if (navigator.onLine && !document.getElementById('summary-modal').classList.contains('active')) {
            try {await AutoXAKOfflineStore.syncPendingTrips();} catch (_) {}
        }
        if (owner!==AutoXAKSession.getUserId()) return;
        currentUserId=owner;
        const headers=AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders();
        let cached={};
        try {
            const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_dashboard_cache') || '{}');
            if (saved.user_id===owner) cached=saved;
        } catch (_) {}
        let totalRub=Number(cached.totalRub)||0, totalTrips=Number(cached.totalTrips)||0;
        let ghostStatus=cached.ghostStatus || 'базовый лихач', resolvedCarId=currentCarId;
        let confirmed=false;
        if (navigator.onLine) {
            const replies=await Promise.allSettled([
                AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON(`/api/v1/users/${encodeURIComponent(owner)}/dashboard`,{headers}),
                AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON(`/api/v1/users/${encodeURIComponent(owner)}/profile`,{headers})
            ]);
            if (owner!==AutoXAKSession.getUserId()) return;
            if (replies[0].status==='fulfilled' && replies[0].value.response.ok) {
                const dash=replies[0].value.data;
                totalRub=Number(dash.total_savings_rub)||0;
                totalTrips=Number(dash.total_trips)||0;
                resolvedCarId=dash.car_id || resolvedCarId;
                ghostStatus=dash.ghost_twin_status?.toLowerCase().includes('базовый') ? 'базовый лихач' : (dash.ghost_twin_status || ghostStatus);
                confirmed=true;
            }
            if (replies[1].status==='fulfilled' && replies[1].value.response.ok && !localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_pending_profile')) {
                const prof=replies[1].value.data;
                resolvedCarId=prof.car_id || resolvedCarId;
                currentCityFuelRate=Number.isFinite(prof.fuel_consumption)?prof.fuel_consumption:null;
                if(currentCityFuelRate!==null)localStorage.setItem("autoXAK_fuel_pass",String(currentCityFuelRate));
                if (prof.car_name) localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_selected_car_name',prof.car_name);
                else if (localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_selected_car_id')!==resolvedCarId) localStorage.removeItem('autoXAK_selected_car_name');
            }
        }
        try {
            const pending=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_pending_profile') || 'null');
            if (pending?.user_id===owner) resolvedCarId=pending.car_id || resolvedCarId;
        } catch (_) {}
        if (!tripActive && !finishingTrip) currentCarId=resolvedCarId;
        localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_selected_car_id',currentCarId);
        const carDisplayName=await resolveCarDisplayName(currentCarId);
        if (owner!==AutoXAKSession.getUserId()) return;
        if (confirmed) {
            try {localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_dashboard_cache',JSON.stringify({user_id:owner,totalRub,totalTrips,ghostStatus}));} catch (_) {}
        }
        document.getElementById('cockpit-car-name').innerText=carDisplayName;
        document.getElementById('cockpit-savings-val').innerText=formatCockpitSavings(totalRub);
        document.getElementById('cockpit-trips-count').innerText=String(totalTrips);
        document.getElementById('savings-empty-caption').hidden=totalTrips>0;
        AutoXAKProgress.refresh('cockpit-progress',7);
        document.getElementById('cockpit-ghost-status').innerText=ghostStatus;
    }

    function logoutAndGoLogin() {
        AutoXAKSession.clearSession();
        window.location.href = '/login';
    }

    // ==================== ПРОВЕРКА ГЕОЛОКАЦИИ И ЗАПУСК ====================
    function closeGeoModals() {
        document.getElementById('modal-geo-denied').classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('modal-geo-disabled').classList.remove('active');
    }

    function retryGeoPermission() {
        closeGeoModals();
        window.alert('Разрешите геолокацию для этого сайта в настройках браузера. Запись поездки продолжается.');
    }

    async function requestStartTrip(forceStartOnDesktop = false) {
        if (tripActive || startingTrip || finishingTrip) return;
        if (pendingFinishedPayload) { await finishActiveTrip(); return; }
        if(currentCityFuelRate===null) {window.alert('Укажите городской расход автомобиля в гараже для расчёта рублей.');window.location.assign('/setup?edit=1');return;}
        let permission = Promise.resolve();
        if (typeof DeviceMotionEvent === 'undefined') {
            captureMotionPermission = 'unsupported';
        } else if (typeof DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission === 'function' && captureMotionPermission === 'unknown') {
            try {
                // iOS requires this call directly in the button's user gesture.
                permission = DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission().then(value=>{
                    captureMotionPermission = value === 'granted' ? 'granted' : 'denied';
                }).catch(()=>{captureMotionPermission='denied';});
            } catch (_) { captureMotionPermission = 'denied'; }
        } else if (typeof DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission !== 'function') {
            captureMotionPermission = 'granted';
        }
        // One watch per trip: do not request a separate initial position. GPS
        // and motion permission prompts are independent and may settle later.
        startingTrip = true;
        try {
            const session = await AutoXAKSession.ensureAuthenticated();
            currentUserId = session.userId;
        } catch (_) {
            startingTrip = false;
            window.alert('Не удалось подтвердить вход. Проверьте соединение или войдите заново.');
            return;
        }
        startingTrip = false;
        const start = beginActiveTrip();
        await permission;
        await start;
    }

    // ==================== АКТИВНАЯ ПОЕЗДКА ====================
    function setTripGlowState(state) {
        const screen = document.getElementById('active-trip-screen');
        screen.classList.remove('glow-green', 'glow-yellow', 'glow-red');
        screen.classList.add(`glow-${state}`);
    }

    async function beginActiveTrip() {
        if (tripActive || startingTrip) return;
        startingTrip = true;

        tripActive = true;
        startingTrip = false;
        activeSessionId = globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : 'session_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
        const recordingSessionId = activeSessionId;
        recordingOwnerId = currentUserId;
        recordingCarId = currentCarId;
        if (navigator.locks) {
            const sessionId=activeSessionId;
            const held=new Promise(resolve=>{releaseRecordingLock=resolve;});
            navigator.locks.request('autoxak-recorder:'+sessionId,()=>held).catch(error=>console.warn('[Recording]',error));
        }
        telemetryStream = [];
        gpsSamples = []; motionSamples = [];
        captureGeoPermission = 'unknown';
        tripStartTime = Date.now();
        draftSaveChain = Promise.resolve();
        saveActiveDraft = () => {
            if (!tripActive) return draftSaveChain;
            const draft = {session_id:activeSessionId, user_id:recordingOwnerId, car_id:recordingCarId,
                telemetry_stream:[...telemetryStream], raw_recording:rawRecording('interrupted')};
            draftSaveChain = draftSaveChain.catch(()=>{}).then(()=>AutoXAKOfflineStore.saveDraftTrip(draft));
            draftSaveChain.catch(error=>console.warn('[Recording]',error));
            return draftSaveChain;
        };
        saveActiveDraft();
        draftTimerInterval = setInterval(saveActiveDraft, 5000);
        lastTickMs = tripStartTime;
        currentSpeedMps = 0.0;
        prevGpsLat = null;
        prevGpsLon = null;
        prevGpsTimeMs = null;
        previousNativeSpeedMps = null;
        lastGpsFixMs = 0; currentLat = currentLon = null;
        lastBumpTime = lastEventTime = 0;

        liveDistanceKm = 0.0;
        liveBumpsCount = 0;
        liveHarshStarts = 0;
        liveHarshBrakes = 0;
        gravInitialized = false;
        lastMotionMs = 0; shockFiltered = 0; shockArmed = true; shockQuietSince = 0;
        lastEstimateRequestMs = 0;

        setTripGlowState('green');
        document.getElementById('trip-timer-display').innerText = "00:00";
        document.getElementById('trip-live-savings').innerText = '+0.00 ₽';
        document.getElementById('trip-live-savings').title = 'Расчёт по выбранному автомобилю и данным поездки.';
        document.getElementById('trip-live-distance').innerText = "0 км";
        document.getElementById('trip-live-bumps').innerText = "0";
        document.getElementById('trip-live-smooth').innerText = "100/100";
        document.getElementById('pill-net-status').innerHTML = navigator.onLine ? "Интернет<br>подключен" : "Интернет<br>оффлайн";
        document.getElementById('pill-gps-status').innerHTML = "GPS<br>поиск...";

        document.getElementById('active-trip-screen').classList.add('active');

        tripTimerInterval = setInterval(() => {
            const nowMs = Date.now();
            lastTickMs = nowMs;

            const elapsed = Math.floor((nowMs - tripStartTime) / 1000);
            const m = String(Math.floor(elapsed / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
            const s = String(elapsed % 60).padStart(2, '0');
            document.getElementById('trip-timer-display').innerText = `${m}:${s}`;

            // Distance is integrated only on actual GPS callbacks, never twice by a timer.
            if (nowMs - lastGpsFixMs > 5000) {
                currentSpeedMps = 0;
                document.getElementById('pill-gps-status').innerHTML = captureGeoPermission==='denied' ? 'GPS<br>нет доступа'
                    : captureGeoPermission==='unsupported' ? 'GPS<br>недоступен'
                    : gpsSamples.length && (gpsSamples[gpsSamples.length-1].accuracy_m===null || gpsSamples[gpsSamples.length-1].accuracy_m>50)
                        ? 'GPS<br>неточный' : 'GPS<br>поиск...';
            }
            if (nowMs - tripStartTime >= 86400000) { finishActiveTrip('duration_limit'); return; }

            document.getElementById('trip-live-distance').innerText = formatDistance(liveDistanceKm);
            document.getElementById('pill-net-status').innerHTML = navigator.onLine ? "Интернет<br>подключен" : "Интернет<br>оффлайн";
            document.getElementById('trip-live-bumps').title = motionSamples.length
                ? `Датчики: ${motionSamples.length} отсчётов. Вертикальные импульсы; дорожные события подтверждаются после поездки.`
                : 'Ожидаем датчики движения. Проверьте разрешение движения и ориентации.';
            updateLiveEstimate();
        }, 1000);

        motionHandler = (event) => {
            if (!tripActive || activeSessionId !== recordingSessionId) return;
            const hasLinear = event.acceleration && ['x','y','z'].every(axis=>Number.isFinite(event.acceleration[axis]));
            const hasGravity = event.accelerationIncludingGravity && ['x','y','z'].every(axis=>Number.isFinite(event.accelerationIncludingGravity[axis]));
            const nowMs = Date.now();
            if (nowMs - tripStartTime >= 86400000) {finishActiveTrip('duration_limit');return;}
            const includesGravity = event.accelerationIncludingGravity && ['x','y','z'].some(axis=>Number.isFinite(event.accelerationIncludingGravity[axis]));
            const source = hasLinear ? event.acceleration : (includesGravity ? event.accelerationIncludingGravity : event.acceleration || {});
            const rotation = event.rotationRate || {};
            const finite = value=>Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
            if (!['x','y','z'].some(axis=>Number.isFinite(source[axis])) && !['alpha','beta','gamma'].some(axis=>Number.isFinite(rotation[axis]))) return;
            if (nowMs < tripStartTime || (motionSamples.length && nowMs <= motionSamples[motionSamples.length-1].timestamp_ms)) return;
            if (motionSamples.length >= 499999) { finishActiveTrip('duration_limit'); return; }
            motionSamples.push({timestamp_ms:nowMs, event_timestamp_ms:Number.isFinite(event.timeStamp) && event.timeStamp>=0 ? event.timeStamp : null,
                ax:finite(source.x), ay:finite(source.y), az:finite(source.z),
                gx:finite(rotation.beta), gy:finite(rotation.gamma), gz:finite(rotation.alpha),
                acceleration_includes_gravity:!hasLinear && !!includesGravity,
                interval_ms:Number.isFinite(event.interval) && event.interval>=0 ? event.interval : null});
            if (!hasLinear && !hasGravity) return;
            const gravityRaw = hasGravity ? event.accelerationIncludingGravity : null;
            const raw = gravityRaw || event.acceleration || {};
            const rot = event.rotationRate || {};

            const rx = Number(raw.x ?? 0.0);
            const ry = Number(raw.y ?? 0.0);
            const rz = Number(raw.z ?? (gravityRaw ? 9.81 : 0));

            const motionDt = lastMotionMs ? Math.min(0.2,Math.max(0.005,(nowMs-lastMotionMs)/1000)) : 0.02;
            if (lastMotionMs && nowMs-lastMotionMs>2000) {shockFiltered=0;shockArmed=true;}
            lastMotionMs = nowMs;
            // When both streams exist, their difference gives gravity without
            // absorbing real vertical acceleration into an EMA estimate.
            if (hasGravity && hasLinear) {
                gravX = rx-event.acceleration.x;
                gravY = ry-event.acceleration.y;
                gravZ = rz-event.acceleration.z;
                gravInitialized = Math.hypot(gravX,gravY,gravZ)>1;
            } else if (!gravInitialized && hasGravity) {
                gravX = rx; gravY = ry; gravZ = rz;
                gravInitialized = true;
            } else if (hasGravity) {
                const alpha = 1-Math.exp(-motionDt/0.8);

                gravY += alpha*(ry-gravY);
                gravZ += alpha*(rz-gravZ);
            }
            if (!gravInitialized) return;

            const deviceX = hasLinear ? event.acceleration.x : rx-gravX;
            const deviceY = hasLinear ? event.acceleration.y : ry-gravY;
            const deviceZ = hasLinear ? event.acceleration.z : rz-gravZ;
            const norm = Math.hypot(gravX,gravY,gravZ);
            if (!Number.isFinite(norm) || norm<1) return;
            const up = [gravX/norm,gravY/norm,gravZ/norm];
            const reference = Math.abs(up[0])<0.8 ? [1,0,0] : [0,1,0];
            const dot = reference[0]*up[0]+reference[1]*up[1]+reference[2]*up[2];
            const horizontal = reference.map((value,i)=>value-dot*up[i]);
            const hnorm = Math.hypot(...horizontal);
            const forward = horizontal.map(value=>value/hnorm);
            const lateral = [up[1]*forward[2]-up[2]*forward[1],up[2]*forward[0]-up[0]*forward[2],up[0]*forward[1]-up[1]*forward[0]];
            const linear = [deviceX,deviceY,deviceZ];
            const linX = linear.reduce((sum,value,i)=>sum+value*forward[i],0);
            const linY = linear.reduce((sum,value,i)=>sum+value*lateral[i],0);
            // Without OS-provided linear acceleration, gravity magnitude is
            // rotation invariant; an EMA direction alone produces false shocks
            // when the phone changes orientation.
            const linZ = hasLinear ? linear.reduce((sum,value,i)=>sum+value*up[i],0)

            if ([linX,linY,9.81+linZ].some(value=>!Number.isFinite(value) || Math.abs(value)>200)) return;

            const hasRecentGps = currentLat !== null && currentLon !== null && nowMs - lastGpsFixMs <= 5000;
            if (telemetryStream.length && nowMs / 1000 <= telemetryStream[telemetryStream.length - 1].t) return;
            if (telemetryStream.length >= 499999) { finishActiveTrip('duration_limit'); return; }
            // Сохраняем в поток значения, приведенные к горизонтальному базису для серверного фильтра Баттерворта
            telemetryStream.push({
                t: Number((nowMs / 1000).toFixed(3)),
                ax: Number(linX.toFixed(4)),
                ay: Number(linY.toFixed(4)),
                az: Number((9.81 + linZ).toFixed(4)),
                gx: Number((Number.isFinite(rot.beta) ? rot.beta : 0).toFixed(4)),
                gy: Number((Number.isFinite(rot.gamma) ? rot.gamma : 0).toFixed(4)),
                gz: Number((Number.isFinite(rot.alpha) ? rot.alpha : 0).toFixed(4)),
                speed: hasRecentGps ? Number(currentSpeedMps.toFixed(2)) : 0,
                lat: hasRecentGps ? Number(currentLat.toFixed(6)) : null,
                lon: hasRecentGps ? Number(currentLon.toFixed(6)) : null
            });
            // The server calculates the descriptive smoothness score.

            // Live sensor impulses are visible during a stationary device check.
            // They do not create distance, driving violations or financial credit.
            const previousShock = shockFiltered;
            shockFiltered += (1-Math.exp(-motionDt/0.04))*(linZ-shockFiltered);
            const jerk = (shockFiltered-previousShock)/motionDt;
            if (Math.abs(shockFiltered)<0.5) {
                if (!shockQuietSince) shockQuietSince=nowMs;
                if (nowMs-shockQuietSince>=120) shockArmed=true;
            } else {shockQuietSince=0;}
            const rotating = Math.hypot(...['alpha','beta','gamma'].map(axis=>Number.isFinite(rot[axis])?rot[axis]:0))>45;
            const shock = Math.abs(shockFiltered)>3.5 || (Math.abs(shockFiltered)>0.8 && Math.abs(jerk)>15);
            if (hasRecentGps && currentSpeedMps >= 2.0 && !rotating && shockArmed && shock && nowMs-lastBumpTime>700 && nowMs-tripStartTime>=120) {
                lastBumpTime = nowMs;
                shockArmed=false;
                liveBumpsCount++;
                document.getElementById('trip-live-bumps').innerText = String(liveBumpsCount);
                return; // Игнорируем продольный отклик во время проезда ямы/лежачего полицейского
            }

            // 2. Детектор резких стартов и торможений по ЧИСТОМУ линейному ускорению
            const horizMag = Math.hypot(linX, linY);
            const signedLong = Math.abs(linX) >= Math.abs(linY) ? linX : linY;

            if (hasRecentGps && currentSpeedMps >= 2.0 && !rotating && horizMag > 2.3 && (nowMs - lastEventTime > 1400)) {
                lastEventTime = nowMs;
                if (signedLong >= 0) liveHarshStarts++; else liveHarshBrakes++;
                // The server calculates the descriptive smoothness score.
                setTripGlowState('red');
            } else if (hasRecentGps && currentSpeedMps >= 2.0 && !rotating && horizMag > 1.4) {
                setTripGlowState('yellow');
            } else if (nowMs - lastEventTime > 1800) {
                setTripGlowState('green');
            }
        };
        window.addEventListener('devicemotion', motionHandler);

        if ('geolocation' in navigator) {
            try {geoWatchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
                (pos) => {
                    if (!tripActive || activeSessionId !== recordingSessionId || !pos || !pos.coords) return;
                    const c = pos.coords;
                    const nowMs = Math.round(Number(pos.timestamp) || Date.now());
                    if (nowMs - tripStartTime >= 86400000) {finishActiveTrip('duration_limit');return;}
                    if (nowMs < tripStartTime || nowMs > Date.now() + 1000 || (gpsSamples.length && nowMs <= gpsSamples[gpsSamples.length-1].timestamp_ms)) return;
                    if (!Number.isFinite(c.latitude) || !Number.isFinite(c.longitude) || Math.abs(c.latitude)>90 || Math.abs(c.longitude)>180) return;
                    if (gpsSamples.length >= 99999) {finishActiveTrip('duration_limit');return;}
                    const accuracy = Number.isFinite(c.accuracy) && c.accuracy>=0 && c.accuracy<=100000 ? c.accuracy : null;
                    const recordedSpeed = Number.isFinite(c.speed) && c.speed>=0 && c.speed<=150 ? c.speed : null;
                    gpsSamples.push({timestamp_ms:nowMs, latitude:c.latitude, longitude:c.longitude,
                        accuracy_m:accuracy, speed_mps:recordedSpeed, speed_source:recordedSpeed===null?'missing':'gps',
                        altitude_m:Number.isFinite(c.altitude) && Math.abs(c.altitude)<=100000 ? c.altitude : null,
                        altitude_accuracy_m:Number.isFinite(c.altitudeAccuracy) && c.altitudeAccuracy>=0 && c.altitudeAccuracy<=100000 ? c.altitudeAccuracy : null,
                        heading_deg:Number.isFinite(c.heading) && c.heading>=0 && c.heading<=360 ? c.heading : null,
                        speed_accuracy_mps:Number.isFinite(c.speedAccuracy) && c.speedAccuracy>=0 && c.speedAccuracy<=150 ? c.speedAccuracy : null});
                    captureGeoPermission = 'granted';
                    const isAccurateGps = accuracy !== null && accuracy <= 50;
                    const nativeSpeed = Number.isFinite(c.speed) && c.speed >= 0 && c.speed <= 75 ? c.speed : null;
                    let derivedSpeed = 0;
                    if (isAccurateGps) {
                        if (prevGpsLat !== null && prevGpsTimeMs !== null) {
                            const dtGps = (nowMs - prevGpsTimeMs) / 1000;
                            const segKm = haversineKm(prevGpsLat, prevGpsLon, c.latitude, c.longitude);
                            if (dtGps > 0.2 && dtGps <= 10) {
                                const stationary = nativeSpeed !== null && previousNativeSpeedMps !== null && Math.max(nativeSpeed,previousNativeSpeedMps)<0.5;
                                if (!stationary && segKm >= (nativeSpeed!==null && previousNativeSpeedMps!==null ? .0002 : .003) && segKm * 1000 / dtGps <= 75) {
                                    liveDistanceKm += segKm;
                                    derivedSpeed = segKm * 1000 / dtGps;
                                } else if (segKm * 1000 / dtGps > 75) {
                                    currentSpeedMps=0;lastGpsFixMs=0;
                                    previousNativeSpeedMps=prevGpsLat=prevGpsLon=prevGpsTimeMs=null;
                                    document.getElementById('pill-gps-status').innerHTML='GPS<br>неточный';
                                    return;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        currentLat = prevGpsLat = c.latitude;
                        currentLon = prevGpsLon = c.longitude;
                        prevGpsTimeMs = lastGpsFixMs = nowMs;
                        previousNativeSpeedMps = nativeSpeed;
                        currentSpeedMps = nativeSpeed ?? derivedSpeed;
                    } else {
                        currentSpeedMps = 0;
                        lastGpsFixMs = 0;
                        previousNativeSpeedMps = prevGpsLat = prevGpsLon = prevGpsTimeMs = null;
                    }
                    document.getElementById('pill-gps-status').innerHTML = isAccurateGps ? "GPS<br>подключен" : "GPS<br>неточный";
                },
                (error) => {
                    if (!tripActive || activeSessionId !== recordingSessionId) return;
                    captureGeoPermission = error.code===1?'denied':'unavailable';
                    if(error.code===1 || error.code===2) document.getElementById(error.code===1?'modal-geo-denied':'modal-geo-disabled').classList.add('active');
                    currentSpeedMps = 0; lastGpsFixMs = 0;
                    previousNativeSpeedMps = prevGpsLat = prevGpsLon = prevGpsTimeMs = null;
                    document.getElementById('pill-gps-status').innerHTML = error.code===1 ? "GPS<br>нет доступа" : "GPS<br>поиск...";

        } else {
            captureGeoPermission = 'unsupported';

        }

    // ==================== СВАЙП ДЛЯ ЗАВЕРШЕНИЯ ====================
    (function initSwipeToStop() {
        const container=document.getElementById('swipe-container'), thumb=document.getElementById('swipe-thumb');
        let pointer=null, start=0, offset=0;
        const maximum=()=>Math.max(1,container.clientWidth-thumb.clientWidth-10);
        thumb.setAttribute('role','button');thumb.tabIndex=0;thumb.setAttribute('aria-label','Завершить поездку');
        thumb.addEventListener('pointerdown', event=>{
            if(pointer!==null || !event.isPrimary || event.button!==0 || finishingTrip || (!tripActive && !pendingFinishedPayload)) return;
            event.preventDefault();pointer=event.pointerId;start=event.clientX;offset=0;
            thumb.setPointerCapture(pointer);thumb.classList.add('dragging');
        });
        thumb.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{
            if(event.pointerId!==pointer) return;
            offset=Math.max(0,Math.min(maximum(),event.clientX-start));thumb.style.transform=`translateX(${offset}px)`;
        });
        function reset(event,complete=false) {
            if(event.pointerId!==pointer) return;
            const finish=complete && offset>=maximum()*.85;
            const id=pointer;pointer=null;offset=0;
            if(thumb.hasPointerCapture(id)) thumb.releasePointerCapture(id);
            thumb.classList.remove('dragging');thumb.style.transform='translateX(0)';
            if(finish) finishActiveTrip();
        }
        thumb.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>reset(e,true));
        thumb.addEventListener('pointercancel',e=>reset(e));
        thumb.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',e=>reset(e));
        thumb.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['Enter',' '].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();finishActiveTrip();}});
    })();

    // ==================== ЗАВЕРШЕНИЕ И ОТКРЫТИЕ ЭКРАНА "ИТОГ ПОЕЗДКИ" ====================
    let finishedResult=null;
    function showTripSummary(result, payload, pending) {
        const value=(id,n,format=String)=>{document.getElementById(id).textContent=Number.isFinite(n)?format(n):'—';};
        value('sum-savings-rub',result.cost_savings_rub,n=>`${n>=0?'+':''}${n.toFixed(2)} ₽`);
        value('sum-starts',result.harsh_accel_count);value('sum-brakes',result.harsh_brake_count);
        value('sum-bumps',result.road_anomalies_count);value('sum-idle',result.traffic_jam_seconds,n=>`${Math.round(n/60)} мин`);
        value('sum-distance',result.distance_km,formatDistance);value('sum-duration',result.duration_seconds,formatDurationHoursMins);
        value('sum-smooth',result.smooth_score,n=>`${n}/100`);
        document.querySelector('#summary-modal .trophy-text').textContent=pending?'Ожидает синхронизации':'Выгода сохранена';
        document.querySelector('#summary-modal .summary-sub-caption').textContent='Сэкономлено на топливе относительно лихача';
        document.getElementById('sum-offline-banner').textContent='Поездка синхронизируется при появлении сети. Итог будет уточнён.';
        document.getElementById('sum-offline-banner').classList.toggle('visible',pending);
        document.getElementById('summary-modal').classList.add('active');
        try {localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_unclaimed_summary',JSON.stringify({user_id:payload.user_id,session_id:result.session_id,result,pending}));} catch(_) {}
    }
    async function finishActiveTrip(endReason='user') {
        if(finishingTrip || (!tripActive && !pendingFinishedPayload)) return;
        finishingTrip=true;tripActive=false;closeGeoModals();
        if(estimateController){estimateController.abort();estimateController=null;}
        clearInterval(tripTimerInterval);clearInterval(draftTimerInterval);
        if(motionHandler) window.removeEventListener('devicemotion',motionHandler);
        if(geoWatchId!==null) navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(geoWatchId);
        geoWatchId=null;
        if(wakeLock){try{await wakeLock.release();}catch(_){}wakeLock=null;}
        const payload=pendingFinishedPayload || {session_id:activeSessionId,user_id:recordingOwnerId,car_id:recordingCarId,
            telemetry_stream:[...telemetryStream],raw_recording:rawRecording(endReason)};
        pendingFinishedPayload=payload;
        await draftSaveChain.catch(()=>{});
        let localSaved=false, result=null;
        try {await AutoXAKOfflineStore.savePendingTrip(payload);localSaved=true;}catch(error){console.warn('Trip local persistence failed:',error.name);}
        if(navigator.onLine) {
            try {
                const reply=await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON('/api/v1/telemetry/session',{method:'POST',
                    headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',...AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders()},body:JSON.stringify(payload)},30000);

        pendingFinishedPayload=null;

            // between the displayed receipt and its credited balance.

        document.getElementById('active-trip-screen').classList.remove('active');

    function saveTripDetailsLocally(sid, details, isOfflineTrip = false) {
        details = {...details, user_id: currentUserId};
        try {
            const map = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_trip_details_map') || '{}');
            map[sid] = details;
            localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_trip_details_map', JSON.stringify(map));

            if (isOfflineTrip) {
                const offList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_offline_trips') || '[]');
                offList.unshift(details);
                localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_offline_trips', JSON.stringify(offList.slice(0, 50)));
            }
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    let lastFinishedSessionId = null;

    let claiming=false;
    async function claimToPiggyBank() {
        if(claiming) return;
        claiming=true;
        const button=document.querySelector('#summary-modal .btn-lime-primary');button.disabled=true;
        try {
            localStorage.removeItem('autoXAK_unclaimed_summary');
            document.getElementById('summary-modal').classList.remove('active');
            await syncCockpitWithBackend();
        } catch(error) {window.alert(error.message);}
        finally {claiming=false;button.disabled=false;}
    }

    window.addEventListener('online', () => {
        syncCockpitWithBackend();
    });

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
        try {
        if (typeof AutoXAKSession !== 'undefined' && AutoXAKSession.ensureAuthenticated) {
            const session = await AutoXAKSession.ensureAuthenticated();
            if (session && session.userId) currentUserId = session.userId;
        }
        try {
            const summary=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_unclaimed_summary')||'null');
            if(summary?.user_id===currentUserId){finishedResult=summary.pending?null:summary.result;lastFinishedSessionId=summary.session_id;showTripSummary(summary.result,{user_id:currentUserId},summary.pending);}
        } catch(_){}
        await AutoXAKOfflineStore.recoverInterruptedTrips();
        await syncCockpitWithBackend();
        } catch(error) {console.warn('Session initialization:',error.message);}
    });

    </script>
</body>
</html>

let authMode='login', submitting=false, blockedUntil=0;
function showWelcome() {
    document.getElementById('welcome-view').hidden=false;
    document.getElementById('credentials-view').hidden=true;
}
function showAuthForm(mode) {
    authMode=mode;
    const register=mode==='register';
    document.getElementById('welcome-view').hidden=true;
    document.getElementById('credentials-view').hidden=false;
    document.getElementById('auth-title').textContent=register?'Создать аккаунт':'Вход';
    document.getElementById('register-description').hidden=!register;
    document.getElementById('auth-submit').textContent=register?'Создать аккаунт':'Войти';
    document.getElementById('auth-switch').textContent=register?'Уже есть аккаунт? Войти':'Нет аккаунта? Зарегистрироваться';
    document.getElementById('auth-password').autocomplete=register?'new-password':'current-password';
    for (const id of ['login-error','password-error','auth-error']) document.getElementById(id).textContent='';
    document.getElementById('auth-error').hidden=true;
}
document.getElementById('toggle-password').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const input=document.getElementById('auth-password'), show=input.type==='password';
    input.type=show?'text':'password';
    document.getElementById('toggle-password').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(show));
    document.getElementById('toggle-password').setAttribute('aria-label',show?'Скрыть пароль':'Показать пароль');
});
async function handleContinueAsGuest() {
    if(submitting) return;
    submitting=true;
    try {await AutoXAKSession.ensureAuthenticated({newGuest:true});window.location.assign('/');}
    catch(error) {document.getElementById('welcome-error').textContent=error.message;}
    finally {submitting=false;}
}
document.getElementById('credentials-form').addEventListener('submit',async event=>{
    event.preventDefault();
    if(submitting) return;
    const login=document.getElementById('auth-login').value, password=document.getElementById('auth-password').value;
    const loginError=/^[a-zA-Z]{5,15}$/.test(login)?'':'Используйте 5–15 латинских букв';
    const passwordError=[...password].length>=8 && [...password].length<=15?'':'Пароль: 8–15 символов';
    document.getElementById('login-error').textContent=loginError;
    document.getElementById('password-error').textContent=passwordError;
    if(loginError || passwordError) return;
    const button=document.getElementById('auth-submit'), errorBox=document.getElementById('auth-error');
    errorBox.hidden=true;
    if(authMode==='login' && Date.now()<blockedUntil) {errorBox.textContent='Слишком много попыток. Попробуйте позже';errorBox.hidden=false;return;}
    submitting=true;button.disabled=true;button.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');
    const mode=authMode, previous=AutoXAKSession.getUserId();
    const guest=AutoXAKSession.isGuest() && previous && AutoXAKSession.getToken();
    try {
        if (guest) await AutoXAKSession.syncPendingProfile();
        const {response,data}=await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON('/api/v1/auth/'+mode, {
            method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',...(guest?AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders():{})},
            body:JSON.stringify({login,password,...(guest?{guest_id:previous}:{})})},15000);
        if(!response.ok) {
            if(mode==='login') document.getElementById('auth-password').value='';
            if(response.status===429) {blockedUntil=Date.now()+1000*(Number(response.headers.get('Retry-After'))||300);}
            if(response.status===409) {document.getElementById('login-error').textContent='Этот логин уже занят';return;}
            throw new Error(typeof data?.detail==='string'?data.detail:'Не удалось выполнить вход. Повторите попытку.');
        }
        if(guest && previous!==data.user_id) await AutoXAKOfflineStore.reassignOwner(previous,data.user_id);
        AutoXAKSession.adoptSession(data);
        window.location.assign('/');
    } catch(error) {errorBox.textContent=error.message;errorBox.hidden=false;}
    finally {submitting=false;button.disabled=false;button.removeAttribute('aria-busy');}
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
