<a id="file-29"></a>

### 7.29. `static/offline_store.js`

Убрано сокращение исходной записи; полная IndexedDB-очередь и подтверждение после успешного POST; сохранение индекса плавности в локальной истории.

- Статус: `M`. Размер итогового файла: 10540 байт.
- SHA-256 после: `2681e0fb7962919dcafb3d39c59bd46df20cb19685f7bf2d5e3e30a22fedbbe0`.
- SHA-256 до: `dd87629c49789c984b3d5da69550da47a3c9b3fb426953401bc7f2da7ad97dbd`.

````javascript
/** Pending trips are acknowledged only after the IndexedDB transaction commits. */
const AutoXAKOfflineStore = window.AutoXAKOfflineStore = (() => {
    const DB_NAME = 'autoXAK_storage', STORE = 'pending_trips', CONTROLS = 'pending_controls';
    let opening = null, syncing = null;

    function openDB() {
        if (opening) return opening;
        opening = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 2);
            request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
                const db = request.result;
                if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(CONTROLS)) db.createObjectStore(CONTROLS, {keyPath: "session_id"});
                if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)) {
                    const store = db.createObjectStore(STORE, {keyPath: 'session_id'});
                    store.createIndex('status', 'status');
                    store.createIndex('created_at', 'created_at');
                }
            };
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                const db = request.result;
                db.onversionchange = () => { db.close(); opening = null; };
                resolve(db);
            };
            request.onerror = () => { opening = null; reject(request.error); };
            request.onblocked = () => { opening = null; reject(new Error('IndexedDB is blocked by another tab')); };
        });
        return opening;
    }

    async function transaction(mode, operation, name = STORE) {
        const db = await openDB();
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const tx = db.transaction(name, mode);
            let result;
            const request = operation(tx.objectStore(name));
            request.onsuccess = () => { result = request.result; };
            tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(result);
            tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error || request.error);
            tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error || new Error('IndexedDB transaction aborted'));
        });
    }

    function savePendingTrip(payload) {
        return transaction('readwrite', store => store.put({...payload, created_at: Date.now(), status: 'PENDING'}));
    }
    async function saveDraftTrip(payload) {
        const db = await openDB();
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const tx = db.transaction(STORE, 'readwrite'), store = tx.objectStore(STORE);
            const request = store.get(payload.session_id);
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                // A delayed write from another tab must not undo finalization.
                if (request.result?.status !== 'PENDING') store.put({...payload, created_at:Date.now(), status:'RECORDING'});
            };
            tx.oncomplete = resolve;
            tx.onerror = tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error || new Error('Draft save failed'));
        });
    }
    async function recoverInterruptedTrips() {
        const drafts = await transaction('readonly', store => store.index('status').getAll('RECORDING'));
        let active = new Set();
        if (navigator.locks) {
            try {
                const locks = await navigator.locks.query();
                active = new Set([...locks.held,...locks.pending].map(lock=>lock.name));
            } catch (_) {return;}
        }
        for (const draft of drafts || []) {
            if (active.has('autoxak-recorder:'+draft.session_id)) continue;
            if (draft.user_id === AutoXAKSession.getUserId() && (draft.raw_recording || (Array.isArray(draft.telemetry_stream) && draft.telemetry_stream.length >= 50))) await savePendingTrip(draft);
        }
    }
    function removePendingTrip(id) { return transaction('readwrite', store => store.delete(id)); }
    async function getPendingTrips() {
        const all = await transaction('readonly', store => store.index('status').getAll('PENDING'));
        const owner = AutoXAKSession.getUserId();
        return (all || []).filter(trip => trip.user_id === owner);
    }
    async function reassignOwner(previous, next) {
        if (AutoXAKSession.getUserId() !== previous) throw new Error('Session changed during account merge');
        const db = await openDB();
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const tx = db.transaction([STORE, CONTROLS], 'readwrite');
            for (const name of [STORE, CONTROLS]) {
                const request = tx.objectStore(name).openCursor();
                request.onsuccess = () => {
                    const cursor = request.result;
                    if (!cursor) return;
                    if (cursor.value.user_id === previous) cursor.update({...cursor.value, user_id: next});
                    cursor.continue();
                };
            }
            tx.oncomplete = resolve;
            tx.onerror = tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error || new Error('Account merge storage failed'));
        });
    }
    async function savePendingControl(session_id, value) {
        const revision = globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : `${Date.now()}:${Math.random()}`;
        return transaction('readwrite', store => store.put({session_id, user_id: AutoXAKSession.getUserId(), value, revision}), CONTROLS);
    }
    async function acknowledgeControl(control) {
        const db = await openDB();
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const tx = db.transaction(CONTROLS, 'readwrite'), store = tx.objectStore(CONTROLS);
            const request = store.get(control.session_id);
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                const current = request.result;
                if (current && current.user_id === control.user_id && current.revision === control.revision && current.value === control.value) store.delete(control.session_id);
            };
            tx.oncomplete = resolve;
            tx.onerror = tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error || new Error('Control acknowledgement failed'));
        });
    }
    async function syncControls(owner) {
        const controls = await transaction('readonly', store => store.getAll(), CONTROLS);
        for (const control of controls || []) {
            if (control.user_id !== owner || AutoXAKSession.getUserId() !== owner) continue;
            const {response} = await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON(`/api/v1/trips/${encodeURIComponent(control.session_id)}/board-computer`, {method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders()},
                body: JSON.stringify({board_computer_consumption_l100km: control.value})});
            if (response.ok) await acknowledgeControl(control);
            else if ([401,403,429].includes(response.status) || response.status >= 500) break;
        }
    }
    async function countPendingTrips() { return (await getPendingTrips()).length; }

    function rememberSyncedTrip(result, trip) {
        if (AutoXAKSession.getUserId() !== trip.user_id) return;
        try {
            const offline = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_offline_trips') || '[]');
            localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_offline_trips', JSON.stringify(offline.filter(item => item.session_id !== trip.session_id)));
            const map = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_trip_details_map') || '{}');
            const details = {user_id:trip.user_id, session_id:result.session_id,
                created_at:new Date(trip.raw_recording?.started_at_ms ?? trip.created_at ?? Date.now()).toISOString(),
                duration_seconds:result.duration_seconds, distance_km:result.distance_km,
                total_savings_rub:result.cost_savings_rub, hard_accel_count:result.harsh_accel_count,
                hard_brake_count:result.harsh_brake_count, bumps_count:result.road_anomalies_count,
                smooth_score:result.smooth_score, idle_minutes:Math.round((result.traffic_jam_seconds || 0)/60), capture_quality:result.metrics?.capture_quality,math_status:result.metrics?.math_status};
            if (trip.session_id !== result.session_id) delete map[trip.session_id];
            map[result.session_id] = details;
            localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_trip_details_map', JSON.stringify(map));
            const archive = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_local_history') || '[]');
            localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_local_history', JSON.stringify([details,...archive.filter(item=>item.user_id===trip.user_id && ![trip.session_id,result.session_id].includes(item.session_id))]));
        } catch (_) { /* The server acknowledgement remains authoritative if cache storage is full. */ }
    }

    async function synchronize(callbacks) {
        if (!navigator.onLine) return;
        const owner = AutoXAKSession.getUserId();
        for (const trip of await getPendingTrips()) {
            if (owner !== AutoXAKSession.getUserId()) break;
            try {
                const {created_at, status, attempts, ...payload} = trip;
                const {response, data:result} = await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON('/api/v1/telemetry/session', {method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders()}, body: JSON.stringify(payload)}, 15000);
                if (!response.ok) {
                    // Retain a rejected record without preventing independent trips
                    // from syncing. Stop on authentication/rate/server failures.
                    if ([400,409,413,422].includes(response.status)) continue;
                    break;
                }
                await removePendingTrip(trip.session_id);
                rememberSyncedTrip(result, trip);
                if (owner === AutoXAKSession.getUserId() && callbacks.onTripSynced) await callbacks.onTripSynced(result, trip);
            } catch (_) { break; }
        }
        try { await syncControls(owner); } catch (_) {}
        if (owner === AutoXAKSession.getUserId() && callbacks.onSyncComplete) await callbacks.onSyncComplete();
    }
    function syncPendingTrips(callbacks = {}) {
        if (!syncing) {
            const owner = AutoXAKSession.getUserId();
            const run = () => synchronize(callbacks);
            syncing = (navigator.locks ? navigator.locks.request('autoxak-sync:'+owner, run) : run()).finally(() => { syncing = null; });
        }
        return syncing;
    }
    return {rememberSyncedTrip, reassignOwner, savePendingControl, saveDraftTrip, recoverInterruptedTrips, savePendingTrip, removePendingTrip, getPendingTrips, countPendingTrips, syncPendingTrips};
})();
````

<a id="file-30"></a>

### 7.30. `static/progress.js`

Новый рендерер прогресса: переключение периодов, актуальность асинхронных ответов, SVG реальных точек и пустые состояния.

- Статус: `A`. Размер итогового файла: 3640 байт.
- SHA-256 после: `79bd1faf050a1b859554845b83ebd792c3ce30b0442b3c2e6eb4b095d39e8417`.
- До изменения файл отсутствовал.

````javascript
const AutoXAKProgress = (() => {
    const revisions=new Map();
    async function refresh(id,days) {
        const root=document.getElementById(id), owner=AutoXAKSession.getUserId();
        if(!root || !owner) return;
        const revision=(revisions.get(id)||0)+1;revisions.set(id,revision);
        root.querySelectorAll('[data-days]').forEach(button=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(Number(button.dataset.days)===days)));
        try {
            const params=new URLSearchParams({days:String(days),utc_offset_minutes:String(-new Date().getTimezoneOffset())});
            const {response,data}=await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON(`/api/v1/users/${encodeURIComponent(owner)}/progress?${params}`,{headers:AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders()});
            if(!response.ok || revisions.get(id)!==revision || AutoXAKSession.getUserId()!==owner) return;
            const values=root.querySelector('.progress-values'), empty=root.querySelector('.progress-empty'), chart=root.querySelector('.progress-chart');
            const available=Number.isFinite(data.average);
            values.style.display=available?'block':'none';
            empty.hidden=data.sufficient_data;
            empty.textContent=available?'Недостаточно данных для динамики. Совершите поездки в другие дни.':'Недостаточно данных. Совершите поездку, чтобы увидеть прогресс.';
            root.querySelector('.progress-number').textContent=available?String(data.average):'—';
            const delta=root.querySelector('.progress-delta');
            delta.textContent=Number.isFinite(data.delta)?`${data.delta>0?'+':''}${data.delta} пунктов`:'';
            delta.className='progress-delta'+(data.delta>0?' positive':data.delta<0?' negative':'');
            root.querySelector('.progress-caption').textContent=`Среднее за последние ${days} дней; сравнение с предыдущими ${days}`;
            if(chart) {
                chart.replaceChildren();chart.style.display=data.sufficient_data?'block':'none';
                if(!data.sufficient_data) return;
                const ns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
                const add=(tag,attrs,text)=>{const e=document.createElementNS(ns,tag);for(const [k,v]of Object.entries(attrs))e.setAttribute(k,v);if(text)e.textContent=text;chart.append(e);return e;};
                for(const score of [0,50,100]) {const y=120-score;add('line',{x1:28,x2:300,y1:y,y2:y,stroke:'#363A3F'});add('text',{x:0,y:y+4,fill:'#8C919B','font-size':10},String(score));}
                let segment=[];
                const flush=()=>{if(segment.length>1)add('polyline',{points:segment.join(' '),fill:'none',stroke:'#D2FA58','stroke-width':2});segment=[];};
                data.points.forEach((point,i)=>{
                    if(!Number.isFinite(point.score)){flush();return;}
                    const x=28+272*i/Math.max(1,data.points.length-1),y=120-point.score;
                    segment.push(`${x},${y}`);const dot=add('circle',{cx:x,cy:y,r:3,fill:'#D2FA58'});
                    const title=document.createElementNS(ns,'title');title.textContent=`${point.date}: ${point.score}`;dot.append(title);
                });flush();
                add('text',{x:28,y:143,fill:'#8C919B','font-size':10},data.period_start);
                add('text',{x:300,y:143,fill:'#8C919B','font-size':10,'text-anchor':'end'},data.period_end);
            }
        } catch(_) { /* Keep the last confirmed display during a network interruption. */ }
    }
    return {refresh};
})();
````

### 7.31. `static/session.js`

Выбор входа до создания гостя, разбор ошибок JSON с сохранением таймаута чтения, очистка кэша итогов/прогресса при смене владельца.

- Статус: `M`. Размер итогового файла: 8488 байт.
- SHA-256 после: `6e774406c7e5ddc85e7f1ee02c3d4214aab5ef4422e1bdcba868a73a09598ea6`.
- SHA-256 до: `37df358bc73e3a69c11b5de114754067963378847153a715995eed68d3af2388`.

````javascript
/** Authentication and service-worker lifecycle shared by all pages. */
const AutoXAKSession = window.AutoXAKSession = (() => {
    let authentication = null;
    let profileSync = null;
    const key = (name) => `autoXAK_${name}`;
    const getToken = () => localStorage.getItem(key('jwt_token')) || '';
    const getUserId = () => localStorage.getItem(key('user_id')) || '';

    // The deadline covers the response body as well as connection setup.
    async function fetchJSON(url, options = {}, timeoutMs = 8000) {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const abort = () => controller.abort();
        if (options.signal?.aborted) abort();
        else options.signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, {once:true});
        const timeout = setTimeout(abort, timeoutMs);
        try {
            const response = await fetch(url, {...options, signal:controller.signal});
            const data = await response.json().catch(error=>{
                if (controller.signal.aborted || !(error instanceof SyntaxError)) throw error;
                return null;
            });
            return {response, data};
        } finally {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            options.signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
        }
    }

    function usableToken(token, userId) {
        try {
            const part = token.split('.')[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
            const claims = JSON.parse(atob(part.padEnd(Math.ceil(part.length / 4) * 4, '=')));
            return claims.sub === userId && Number.isFinite(claims.exp) && claims.exp * 1000 > Date.now();
        } catch (_) { return false; }
    }

    function storeSession(data) {
        const previous = getUserId();
        if (previous && previous !== data.user_id) {
            for (const name of ['trip_details_map', 'offline_trips', 'local_history', 'profile', 'car_id', 'car_name', 'selected_car_id', 'selected_car_name', 'pending_profile', 'fuel_price', 'fuel_pass', 'dashboard_cache', 'unclaimed_summary', 'progress_cache']) {
                localStorage.removeItem(key(name));
            }
        }
        localStorage.setItem(key('jwt_token'), data.token);
        localStorage.setItem(key('user_id'), data.user_id);
        localStorage.setItem(key('is_guest'), String(data.is_guest !== false));
        localStorage.setItem(key('user_name'), data.name || 'Гость');
        return {token: data.token, userId: data.user_id, isGuest: data.is_guest !== false, name: data.name || 'Гость'};
    }

    async function serverAcceptsToken(token) {
        if (!navigator.onLine) return true;
        try {
            const {response, data} = await fetchJSON('/api/v1/auth/me', {
                headers: {'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`},
                cache: 'no-store'
            }, 5000);
            if (response.ok && getToken() === token && data.user_id === getUserId() && usableToken(data.token, data.user_id)) {
                localStorage.setItem(key('jwt_token'), data.token);
            }
            // Only an explicit rejection invalidates the local session. Network
            // outages and server failures must preserve offline recording access.
            return response.status !== 401;
        } catch (_) { return true; }
    }

    async function authenticate(options) {
        const token = getToken(), userId = getUserId();
        if (usableToken(token, userId) && await serverAcceptsToken(token)) {
            return {token:getToken(), userId, isGuest: localStorage.getItem(key('is_guest')) !== 'false', name: localStorage.getItem(key('user_name')) || 'Гость'};
        }
        localStorage.removeItem(key('jwt_token'));
        if (userId && !options.newGuest) {
            if (navigator.onLine) window.location.replace('/login');
            throw new Error('Для восстановления сессии необходимо войти заново');
        }
        if (!options.newGuest) {window.location.replace('/login');throw new Error('Выберите способ входа');}
        const {response, data} = await fetchJSON('/api/v1/auth/guest', {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: '{}'});
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Не удалось создать сессию: HTTP ${response.status}`);
        return storeSession(data);
    }

    function ensureAuthenticated(options = {}) {
        if (!authentication) {
            authentication = authenticate(options).finally(() => { authentication = null; });
        }
        return authentication;
    }

    function getAuthHeaders() {
        const token = getToken();
        return token ? {'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`} : {};
    }

    async function syncProfileOnce() {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(key('pending_profile'));
        if (!saved) return true;
        try {
            const pending = JSON.parse(saved);
            if (pending.user_id !== getUserId() || !navigator.onLine) return false;
            const {response} = await fetchJSON(`/api/v1/users/${encodeURIComponent(pending.user_id)}/profile`, {
                method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json', ...getAuthHeaders()},
                body:JSON.stringify(pending)});
            if (!response.ok) return false;
            if (localStorage.getItem(key('pending_profile')) === saved) localStorage.removeItem(key('pending_profile'));
            return true;
        } catch (_) {return false;}
    }
    function syncPendingProfile() {
        if (!profileSync) {
            const owner=getUserId();
            const run=async()=>{
                while (localStorage.getItem(key('pending_profile'))) {
                    if (owner!==getUserId() || !(await syncProfileOnce())) return false;
                }
                return true;
            };
            profileSync=(navigator.locks ? navigator.locks.request('autoxak-profile:'+owner,run) : run()).finally(()=>{profileSync=null;});
        }
        return profileSync;
    }
    async function saveProfile(payload) {
        if (payload.user_id !== getUserId()) throw new Error('Session changed during profile save');
        localStorage.setItem(key('pending_profile'), JSON.stringify(payload));
        return syncPendingProfile();
    }

    function clearSession() {
        for (const name of ['jwt_token', 'user_id', 'is_guest', 'user_name', 'trip_details_map', 'offline_trips', 'local_history', 'profile', 'car_id', 'car_name', 'selected_car_id', 'selected_car_name', 'pending_profile', 'fuel_price', 'fuel_pass', 'dashboard_cache', 'unclaimed_summary', 'progress_cache']) localStorage.removeItem(key(name));
    }

    async function loginWithYandex() {
        const token = getToken();
        const accepted = usableToken(token, getUserId()) && await serverAcceptsToken(token);
        if (!accepted) localStorage.removeItem(key('jwt_token'));
        if (accepted && !(await syncPendingProfile())) throw new Error("Сначала синхронизируйте изменения автомобиля");
        const {response, data} = await fetchJSON('/api/v1/auth/yandex/login', {
            method: 'POST', headers: usableToken(getToken(), getUserId()) ? getAuthHeaders() : {}
        });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Вход через Яндекс сейчас недоступен');
        window.location.assign(data.url);
    }

    async function registerServiceWorker() {
        if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return;
        try {
            const registrations = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations();
            for (const registration of registrations) {
                const worker = registration.active || registration.waiting || registration.installing;
                if (worker && new URL(worker.scriptURL).pathname === '/static/sw.js') await registration.unregister();
            }
            await navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', {scope: '/'});
        } catch (error) { console.warn('[PWA]', error); }
    }
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') registerServiceWorker();
    else window.addEventListener('load', registerServiceWorker, {once: true});

    return {fetchJSON, saveProfile, syncPendingProfile, adoptSession: storeSession, ensureAuthenticated, clearSession, loginWithYandex, getAuthHeaders, getUserId, getToken,
            isGuest: () => localStorage.getItem(key('is_guest')) !== 'false'};
})();
````

````html
                    <path d="M143 50V23H167L192 50H143Z" stroke="#D2FA58" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
                    <circle cx="71" cy="96" r="20" fill="#1C1E22" stroke="#D2FA58" stroke-width="2.3"/>
                    <circle cx="71" cy="96" r="11.5" stroke="#D2FA58" stroke-width="2.3"/>
                    <circle cx="207" cy="96" r="20" fill="#1C1E22" stroke="#D2FA58" stroke-width="2.3"/>
                    <circle cx="207" cy="96" r="11.5" stroke="#D2FA58" stroke-width="2.3"/>
                </svg>
            </div>

            <div class="current-car-name" id="garage-current-car-name">Haval Jolion 1.5T 4WD</div>
        </div>

            <button class="btn-lime" type="button" onclick="openEditScreen()">Изменить автомобиль</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ================= ЭКРАН 2: ИЗМЕНИТЬ АВТОМОБИЛЬ (МАКЕТЫ 2 И 3) ================= -->
    <div class="view-screen" id="screen-garage-edit">
        <button class="back-nav-btn" type="button" onclick="closeEditScreen()">
            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"></line>
                <polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"></polyline>
            </svg>

        </button>

        <h1 class="edit-title">Изменить автомобиль</h1>

        <!-- Переключатель вкладок -->
        <div class="segmented-control">
            <button class="segment-btn active" id="tab-btn-registry" type="button" onclick="switchEditMode('registry')">Из реестра</button>
            <button class="segment-btn" id="tab-btn-manual" type="button" onclick="switchEditMode('manual')">Вручную</button>
        </div>

        <!-- ВКЛАДКА 1: ИЗ РЕЕСТРА (МАКЕТ 2) -->
        <div class="tab-pane active" id="pane-registry">

            <!-- Марка -->
            <div class="field-group">
                <label class="field-label">Марка</label>
                <div class="split-select-wrap" id="wrap-make">
                    <div class="split-select-value-box" id="label-make">Haval</div>
                    <div class="split-select-arrow-box">
                        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">

                        </svg>

                    <select class="native-select-overlay" id="select-make" onchange="onMakeChange()"></select>

            </div>

            <!-- Модель -->
            <div class="field-group">
                <label class="field-label">Модель</label>
                <div class="split-select-wrap" id="wrap-model">
                    <div class="split-select-value-box" id="label-model">Jolion</div>
                    <div class="split-select-arrow-box">
                        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline>
                        </svg>

                    <select class="native-select-overlay" id="select-model" onchange="onModelChange()"></select>
                    <div class="custom-dropdown-menu"></div>

            <!-- Модификация -->
            <div class="field-group">
                <label class="field-label">Модификация</label>
                <div class="split-select-wrap" id="wrap-trim">
                    <div class="split-select-value-box" id="label-trim">1.5T 4WD</div>
                    <div class="split-select-arrow-box">
                        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline>
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <select class="native-select-overlay" id="select-trim" onchange="onTrimChange()"></select>
                    <div class="custom-dropdown-menu"></div>

            <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label" for="registry-fuel">Городской расход, л/100 км</label>
                <input class="text-input-box" id="registry-fuel" type="number" min="0.1" max="100" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Из паспорта автомобиля">
                <span class="field-hint">Используется для расчётной экономии</span></div>
            <div class="bottom-cta-spacer">
                <button class="btn-lime" type="button" onclick="saveRegistryVehicle()">Сохранить</button>
                <button class="segment-btn" onclick="switchEditMode('manual')">Моего автомобиля нет в списке</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ВКЛАДКА 2: ВРУЧНУЮ (МАКЕТ 3) -->
        <div class="tab-pane" id="pane-manual">
            <!-- Название автомобиля -->
            <div class="field-group">
                <label class="field-label" for="input-custom-name">Название автомобиля</label>
                <input type="text" class="text-input-box" id="input-custom-name" placeholder="Введите название" maxlength="12" autocomplete="off">

            <!-- Тип кузова -->
            <div class="field-group">
                <label class="field-label">Тип кузова</label>
                <div class="split-select-wrap">
                    <div class="split-select-value-box" id="label-body">Кроссовер</div>
                    <div class="split-select-arrow-box">
                        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline>
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <select class="native-select-overlay" id="select-body" onchange="syncManualLabel('select-body', 'label-body')">
                        <option value="crossover" selected>Кроссовер</option>
                        <option value="sedan">Седан</option>
                        <option value="hatchback">Хэтчбек</option>
                        <option value="wagon">Универсал</option>
                        <option value="suv">Внедорожник</option>
                        <option value="coupe">Купе</option>

                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Снаряженная масса, кг -->
            <div class="field-group">
                <label class="field-label">Снаряженная масса, кг</label>
                <div class="split-select-wrap">
                    <div class="split-select-value-box" id="label-mass">1 600</div>
                    <div class="split-select-arrow-box">
                        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline>
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <select class="native-select-overlay" id="select-mass" onchange="syncManualLabel('select-mass', 'label-mass')">
                        <option value="1100">1 100</option>
                        <option value="1200">1 200</option>
                        <option value="1300">1 300</option>
                        <option value="1400">1 400</option>
                        <option value="1500">1 500</option>
                        <option value="1600" selected>1 600</option>
                        <option value="1700">1 700</option>
                        <option value="1800">1 800</option>
                        <option value="1900">1 900</option>
                        <option value="2000">2 000</option>
                        <option value="2200">2 200</option>
                        <option value="2500">2 500</option>
                    </select>
                    <div class="custom-dropdown-menu"></div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Объем двигателя -->
            <div class="field-group">
                <label class="field-label">Объем двигателя</label>
                <div class="split-select-wrap">
                    <div class="split-select-value-box" id="label-engine">1.5 л</div>
                    <div class="split-select-arrow-box">
                        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline>
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <select class="native-select-overlay" id="select-engine" onchange="syncManualLabel('select-engine', 'label-engine')">
                        <option value="1.2">1.2 л</option>
                        <option value="1.4">1.4 л</option>
                        <option value="1.5" selected>1.5 л</option>
                        <option value="1.6">1.6 л</option>
                        <option value="1.8">1.8 л</option>
                        <option value="2.0">2.0 л</option>
                        <option value="2.4">2.4 л</option>
                        <option value="2.5">2.5 л</option>
                        <option value="3.0">3.0 л</option>
                        <option value="3.5">3.5 л</option>
                    </select>
                    <div class="custom-dropdown-menu"></div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Привод -->
            <div class="field-group">
                <label class="field-label">Привод</label>
                <div class="split-select-wrap">
                    <div class="split-select-value-box" id="label-drive">Полный</div>
                    <div class="split-select-arrow-box">
                        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline>
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <select class="native-select-overlay" id="select-drive" onchange="syncManualLabel('select-drive', 'label-drive')">
                        <option value="FWD">Передний</option>
                        <option value="AWD" selected>Полный</option>
                        <option value="RWD">Задний</option>
                    </select>
                    <div class="custom-dropdown-menu"></div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Коробка передач -->
            <div class="field-group">
                <label class="field-label">Коробка передач</label>
                <div class="split-select-wrap">
                    <div class="split-select-value-box" id="label-transmission">Роботизированная</div>
                    <div class="split-select-arrow-box">
                        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline>
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <select class="native-select-overlay" id="select-transmission" onchange="syncManualLabel('select-transmission', 'label-transmission')">
                        <option value="DCT" selected>Роботизированная</option>
                        <option value="AT">Автоматическая</option>
                        <option value="CVT">Вариатор</option>
                        <option value="MT">Механическая</option>
                    </select>
                    <div class="custom-dropdown-menu"></div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label" for="manual-fuel">Городской расход, л/100 км</label>
                <input class="text-input-box" id="manual-fuel" type="number" min="0.1" max="100" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Из паспорта автомобиля">
                <span class="field-hint">Используется для расчётной экономии</span></div>
            <div class="bottom-cta-spacer">
                <button class="btn-lime" type="button" onclick="saveManualVehicle()">Сохранить</button>
            </div>

    <!-- Нижняя панель навигации с подписями -->
    <nav class="bottom-tab-bar" id="bottom-tab-bar">
        <a href="/history" class="tab-item" aria-label="История поездок">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"/>
                <path d="M3 3v5h5"/>
                <path d="M12 7v5l4 2"/>
            </svg>
        </a>
        <a href="/" class="tab-item" aria-label="Главный экран">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="M3 9.5L12 3l9 6.5V20a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6h-6v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V9.5z"/>
            </svg>
        </a>
        <a href="/setup" class="tab-item active" aria-label="Мой автомобиль">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="M14 16H9m10 0h3v-3.15a1 1 0 0 0-.84-.99L16 11l-2.7-3.6a1 1 0 0 0-.8-.4H5.24a2 2 0 0 0-1.8 1.1l-.8 1.63A6 6 0 0 0 2 12.42V16h2"/>
                <circle cx="6.5" cy="16.5" r="2.5"/>
                <circle cx="16.5" cy="16.5" r="2.5"/>
            </svg>
        </a>
    </nav>

</div>

<script>
    'use strict';

    let currentUserId = localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_user_id') || '';

    let catalogTree = [];

    // ---------------- ПЕРЕКЛЮЧЕНИЕ ЭКРАНОВ И НАТИВНЫЕ СПИСКИ ----------------
    function openEditScreen() {
        document.getElementById('screen-garage-view').classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('screen-garage-edit').classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById('bottom-tab-bar').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function closeEditScreen() {
        document.getElementById('screen-garage-edit').classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('screen-garage-view').classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById('bottom-tab-bar').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function switchEditMode(mode) {
        const isRegistry = mode === 'registry';
        document.getElementById('tab-btn-registry').classList.toggle('active', isRegistry);
        document.getElementById('tab-btn-manual').classList.toggle('active', !isRegistry);
        document.getElementById('pane-registry').classList.toggle('active', isRegistry);
        document.getElementById('pane-manual').classList.toggle('active', !isRegistry);
    }

    function syncManualLabel(selectId, labelId) {
        const sel = document.getElementById(selectId);
        const lbl = document.getElementById(labelId);
        if (sel && lbl && sel.options[sel.selectedIndex]) {
            lbl.innerText = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].text;
        }
    }

    // ---------------- ОЧИСТКА МОДИФИКАЦИИ ОТ ПОВТОРА МАРКИ/МОДЕЛИ ----------------
    function cleanTrimBadge(rawBadge, makeName, modelName) {
        if (!rawBadge) return 'Базовая';
        let cleaned = String(rawBadge).trim();
        if (makeName) {
            const reMake = new RegExp('^' + makeName.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '\\s*', 'i');
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(reMake, '');
        }
        if (modelName) {
            const reModel = new RegExp('^' + modelName.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '\\s*', 'i');
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(reModel, '');
        }
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\s*\(\d+\s*л\.?с\.?\)/i, '').trim();
        return cleaned || rawBadge;
    }

    // ---------------- ЗАГРУЗКА И ПАРСИНГ КАТАЛОГА ----------------
    function normalizeCatalogData(raw) {
        const items = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : (raw && Array.isArray(raw.catalog) ? raw.catalog : []);
        if (!items.length) return [];

        if (items[0] && Array.isArray(items[0].models)) {
            return items.map(mk => ({
                id: mk.id || mk.name,
                name: mk.name || mk.id,
                models: (mk.models || []).map(md => ({
                    id: md.id || md.name,
                    name: md.name || md.id,
                    trims: (md.trims || []).map(tr => ({
                        id: tr.id,
                        badge_name: cleanTrimBadge(tr.badge_name || tr.name || tr.id, mk.name, md.name),
                        fuel_rate: tr.base_city_fuel_rate_l100km ?? null,
                        mass_kg: tr.curb_weight_kg ?? null
                    }))
                }))
            }));
        }

        const makesMap = Object.create(null);
        for (const item of items) {
            const mkName = item.make || item.brand || item.name || 'Марка';
            const mdName = item.model || 'Модель';
            if (!makesMap[mkName]) {
                makesMap[mkName] = { id: mkName.toLowerCase(), name: mkName, models: Object.create(null) };
            }
            if (!makesMap[mkName].models[mdName]) {
                makesMap[mkName].models[mdName] = { id: mdName.toLowerCase(), name: mdName, trims: [] };
            }
            const rawTrimName = item.trim || item.badge_name || item.full_name || item.id;
            makesMap[mkName].models[mdName].trims.push({
                id: item.id,
                badge_name: cleanTrimBadge(rawTrimName, mkName, mdName),
                fuel_rate: item.base_city_fuel_rate_l100km ?? null,
                mass_kg: item.curb_weight_kg ?? null
            });
        }

        const tree = Object.values(makesMap).map(mk => ({
            id: mk.id,
            name: mk.name,
            models: Object.values(mk.models)
        }));

        return tree.length > 0 ? tree : [];
    }

    async function initCatalog() {
        try {
            const {response:res, data:raw} = await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON('/api/v1/vehicles/catalog');
            if (res.ok) {
                catalogTree = normalizeCatalogData(raw);
            } else {
                catalogTree = [];
            }
        } catch (e) {
            catalogTree = [];
        }
        document.getElementById("catalog-status").textContent = catalogTree.length ? "" : "Каталог сейчас недоступен. Можно добавить автомобиль вручную.";
        populateMakes();
    }

    function populateMakes() {
        const makeSel = document.getElementById('select-make');
        makeSel.replaceChildren(...catalogTree.map(mk => new Option(mk.name,mk.id)));
        onMakeChange();
    }

    function onMakeChange() {
        const makeSel = document.getElementById('select-make');
        const makeId = makeSel.value;
        const makeObj = catalogTree.find(m => String(m.id) === String(makeId)) || catalogTree[0];

        document.getElementById('label-make').innerText = makeObj ? makeObj.name : '';

        const modelSel = document.getElementById('select-model');
        const models = makeObj ? makeObj.models : [];
        modelSel.replaceChildren(...models.map(md => new Option(md.name,md.id)));
        onModelChange();
    }

    function onModelChange() {
        const makeId = document.getElementById('select-make').value;
        const modelId = document.getElementById('select-model').value;
        const makeObj = catalogTree.find(m => String(m.id) === String(makeId)) || catalogTree[0];
        const modelObj = makeObj ? (makeObj.models.find(md => String(md.id) === String(modelId)) || makeObj.models[0]) : null;

        document.getElementById('label-model').innerText = modelObj ? modelObj.name : '';

        const trimSel = document.getElementById('select-trim');
        const trims = modelObj ? modelObj.trims : [];
        trimSel.replaceChildren(...trims.map(tr => new Option(tr.badge_name,tr.id)));
        onTrimChange();
    }

    function onTrimChange() {
        const trimSel = document.getElementById('select-trim');
        const opt = trimSel.options[trimSel.selectedIndex];
        document.getElementById('label-trim').innerText = opt ? opt.text : '';
        const selected = catalogTree.flatMap(m=>m.models).flatMap(m=>m.trims).find(t=>t.id===trimSel.value);
        document.getElementById('registry-fuel').value = selected?.fuel_rate ?? '';
    }

    function selectTrimInDropdowns(targetCarId) {
        if (!targetCarId) return false;
        for (const mk of catalogTree) {
            for (const md of mk.models) {
                const foundTrim = md.trims.find(t => String(t.id) === String(targetCarId));
                if (foundTrim) {
                    document.getElementById('select-make').value = mk.id;
                    onMakeChange();
                    document.getElementById('select-model').value = md.id;
                    onModelChange();
                    document.getElementById('select-trim').value = foundTrim.id;
                    onTrimChange();
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ---------------- ЗАГРУЗКА ТЕКУЩЕГО АВТОМОБИЛЯ ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЯ ----------------
    async function loadUserGarageState() {
        if (window.AutoXAKSession && typeof window.AutoXAKSession.getUserId === 'function') {
            const sid = window.AutoXAKSession.getUserId();
            if (sid) currentUserId = sid;
        }

        let carName = localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_car_name') || '';
        let carId = localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_car_id') || '';
        let fuelRate = Number(localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_fuel_pass')) || null;

        const savedProfile = localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_profile');
        if (savedProfile) {
            try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(savedProfile);
                if (!carName && parsed.car_name) carName = parsed.car_name;
                if (!carId && parsed.car_id) carId = parsed.car_id;
            } catch (_) {}
        }

        try {
            const headers = (window.AutoXAKSession && typeof window.AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders === 'function')
                ? window.AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders()
                : {};
            const {response:res, data:prof} = await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON(`/api/v1/users/${encodeURIComponent(currentUserId)}/profile`, { headers });
            if (res.ok) {
                if (!localStorage.getItem('autoXAK_pending_profile')) {
                    carName = prof.car_name || '';
                    carId = prof.car_id || '';
                    fuelRate = prof.fuel_consumption;
                    for (const prefix of ['autoXAK_', 'autoXAK_selected_']) {
                        localStorage.setItem(prefix+'car_id', carId);
                        localStorage.setItem(prefix+'car_name', carName);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_) {}

        const matchedCar = carId && selectTrimInDropdowns(carId);
        if (matchedCar && Number.isFinite(fuelRate)) document.getElementById("registry-fuel").value=fuelRate;

        if (!carName) {
            const mk = matchedCar ? document.getElementById('label-make').innerText : '';
            const md = document.getElementById('label-model').innerText;
            const tr = document.getElementById('label-trim').innerText;
            carName = (mk && md) ? `${mk} ${md} ${tr}`.trim() : 'Мой автомобиль';
        }

        document.getElementById('garage-current-car-name').innerText = carName;
    }

    // ---------------- СОХРАНЕНИЕ: ИЗ РЕЕСТРА (МАКЕТ 2) ----------------
    async function saveRegistryVehicle() {
        const makeName = document.getElementById('label-make').innerText.trim();
        const modelName = document.getElementById('label-model').innerText.trim();
        const trimBadge = document.getElementById('label-trim').innerText.trim();
        const trimId = document.getElementById('select-trim').value;
        if (!trimId) {window.alert('Каталог пуст. Добавьте автомобиль вручную.');return;}

        const fullCarName = `${makeName} ${modelName} ${trimBadge}`.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

        let fuelPass = null;
        for (const mk of catalogTree) {
            for (const md of mk.models) {
                const tr = md.trims.find(x => String(x.id) === String(trimId));
                if (tr && tr.fuel_rate) {
                    fuelPass = tr.fuel_rate;
                }
            }
        }

        await persistVehicleSelection({
            car_id: trimId,
            car_name: fullCarName,
            fuel_consumption: Number(document.getElementById("registry-fuel").value) || fuelPass
        });
    }

    // ---------------- СОХРАНЕНИЕ: ВРУЧНУЮ (МАКЕТ 3) ----------------
    async function saveManualVehicle() {
        const rawInputName = document.getElementById('input-custom-name').value.trim();
        if (!rawInputName || [...rawInputName].length>12) {window.alert('Название: от 1 до 12 символов');return;}
        const customCarName = rawInputName;
        const declaredFuel = Number(document.getElementById('manual-fuel').value);
        if (!Number.isFinite(declaredFuel) || declaredFuel<=0 || declaredFuel>100) {window.alert('Для расчёта рублей укажите городской расход больше 0 и до 100 л/100 км.');return;}

        const bodyType = document.getElementById('select-body').value;
        const massKg = parseInt(document.getElementById('select-mass').value, 10) || 1600;
        const engineL = parseFloat(document.getElementById('select-engine').value) || 1.5;
        const driveType = document.getElementById('select-drive').value;
        const transType = document.getElementById('select-transmission').value;

        let synthesizedCarId = null;

        try {
            const {response:synRes, data:synData} = await AutoXAKSession.fetchJSON('/api/v1/vehicles/synthesize', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders() },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    custom_name: customCarName,
                    body_type: bodyType,
                    curb_weight_kg: massKg,
                    engine_displacement_l: engineL,
                    drivetrain_type: driveType,
                    transmission_type: transType
                })
            });
            if (!synRes.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${synRes.status}`);
            if (synRes.ok) {
                if (synData.car_id || synData.id) {
                    synthesizedCarId = synData.car_id || synData.id;
                }
            }
        } catch (_) { window.alert('Не удалось сохранить характеристики автомобиля. Проверьте соединение и повторите.'); return; }

        if (!synthesizedCarId) {window.alert('Сервер не вернул идентификатор автомобиля. Повторите сохранение.');return;}
        await persistVehicleSelection({
            car_id: synthesizedCarId,
            car_name: customCarName,
            fuel_consumption: declaredFuel,
            curb_weight_kg: massKg,
            engine_displacement_l: engineL,
            drivetrain_type: driveType,
            transmission_type: transType
        });
    }

    // ---------------- ЕДИНАЯ ФУНКЦИЯ СОХРАНЕНИЯ И СИНХРОНИЗАЦИИ ----------------
    async function persistVehicleSelection(vehicleData) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(vehicleData.fuel_consumption) || vehicleData.fuel_consumption<=0 || vehicleData.fuel_consumption>100) {window.alert('Для расчёта рублей укажите городской расход больше 0 и до 100 л/100 км.');return;}
        localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_car_id', vehicleData.car_id);
        localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_car_name', vehicleData.car_name);
        localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_selected_car_id', vehicleData.car_id);
        localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_selected_car_name', vehicleData.car_name);
        if (Number.isFinite(vehicleData.fuel_consumption)) localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_fuel_pass',String(vehicleData.fuel_consumption));
        else localStorage.removeItem('autoXAK_fuel_pass');

        const profilePayload = {
            user_id: currentUserId,
            car_id: vehicleData.car_id,
            car_name: vehicleData.car_name,
            fuel_consumption: vehicleData.fuel_consumption ?? null
        };
        localStorage.setItem('autoXAK_profile', JSON.stringify(profilePayload));

        document.getElementById('garage-current-car-name').innerText = vehicleData.car_name;

        await AutoXAKSession.saveProfile(profilePayload);

        closeEditScreen();
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
        try {
        const session = await AutoXAKSession.ensureAuthenticated();
        currentUserId = session.userId;
        await AutoXAKSession.syncPendingProfile();
        // Native select preserves iOS, keyboard and screen-reader access.
        await initCatalog();
        await loadUserGarageState();

        if (window.location.search.includes('edit=1')) {
            openEditScreen();
        }
        } catch(error) {console.warn('Garage initialization:',error.message);}
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>
````

### 7.33. `static/sw.js`

Новая версия кэша autoxak-shell-v6 и новые CSS/JS в app shell.

- Статус: `M`. Размер итогового файла: 2280 байт.
- SHA-256 после: `828fe2d21f89f52b0d64e87502722648f23f09c6a984476b44aeac945ea8a958`.
- SHA-256 до: `402e0eb2eac9f1c1137e34c6f61f61fe015b51ffca128039021043340a3fe884`.

````javascript
const CACHE_NAME = 'autoxak-shell-v6';
const STATIC_ASSETS = ['/', '/setup', '/history', '/login', '/static/session.js', '/static/app.css', '/static/auth.css', '/static/progress.js', '/static/offline_store.js', '/static/manifest.json', '/static/icon-192.png', '/static/icon-512.png'];
self.addEventListener('install', event => {
    event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => cache.addAll(STATIC_ASSETS)).then(() => self.skipWaiting()));
});
self.addEventListener('activate', event => {
    event.waitUntil(caches.keys().then(keys => Promise.all(keys.filter(key => key.startsWith('autoxak-shell-') && key !== CACHE_NAME).map(key => caches.delete(key)))).then(() => self.clients.claim()));
});
self.addEventListener('fetch', event => {
    const url = new URL(event.request.url);
    if (event.request.method !== 'GET' || url.origin !== self.location.origin || !STATIC_ASSETS.includes(url.pathname)) return;
    event.respondWith((async () => {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 7000);
        let fallback;
        try {
            const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_NAME);
            // Queries do not create unbounded duplicate copies of the app shell.
            fallback = await cache.match(url.pathname);
            const response = await fetch(event.request, {signal:controller.signal});
            if (!response.ok || response.redirected) return fallback || response;
            // Finish reading under the same deadline: headers alone are insufficient.
            const body = await response.arrayBuffer();
            const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
            // fetch already decoded gzip/br; these headers describe wire bytes.
            headers.delete('content-encoding');
            headers.delete('content-length');
            headers.delete('transfer-encoding');
            const complete = new Response(body, {
                status:response.status, statusText:response.statusText, headers
            });
            try {await cache.put(url.pathname, complete.clone());} catch (_) {}
            return complete;
        } catch (_) {
            return fallback || Response.error();
        } finally {clearTimeout(timeout);}
    })());
});
````

### 7.35. `tests/browser/live_metrics.cjs`

Регрессии стоянки/скорости для ударов, движущегося предпросмотра денег, устаревших ответов и полной длинной записи.

- Статус: `M`. Размер итогового файла: 7979 байт.
- SHA-256 после: `8d9dc9c993eac3b4b65343f5415608a559e911d029d1a0a13b541aa49e48dd08`.
- SHA-256 до: `7e7c44dd56a687f7fcd63c3c7436951339322cd3a4070f15ac0e57824641ebc8`.

````javascript
const {chromium} = require('playwright');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const base = process.env.AUTOXAK_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';

(async()=>{
    const browser = await chromium.launch({executablePath:process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH || '/usr/bin/chromium',headless:true,args:['--no-sandbox']});
    try {
        const context = await browser.newContext();
        const page = await context.newPage();
        const errors=[];
        page.on('pageerror',error=>errors.push(error.message));
        await page.goto(base+'/login');
        await page.click('.btn-guest');
        await page.waitForURL(base+'/');
        await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.AutoXAKOfflineStore);
        const headers=await page.evaluate(()=>AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders());
        const owner=await page.evaluate(()=>AutoXAKSession.getUserId());
        await page.evaluate(()=>{
            let clock=Date.now(),gps,meters=0;
            Date.now=()=>clock;
            window.__advance=ms=>{clock+=ms;};
            Object.defineProperty(DeviceMotionEvent,'requestPermission',{configurable:true,value:()=>Promise.resolve('granted')});
            Object.defineProperty(navigator,'geolocation',{configurable:true,value:{
                watchPosition:callback=>{gps=callback;return 0;},clearWatch:()=>{}
            }});
            window.__gps=speed=>{meters+=speed;gps({timestamp:clock,coords:{latitude:55.75+meters/111194.9266,longitude:37.61,accuracy:5,speed}});};
            window.__motion=(gravity,linear=[0,0,0],rotation=0,withLinear=true)=>{
                clock+=20;
                const event=new Event('devicemotion');
                Object.defineProperties(event,{
                    acceleration:{value:withLinear?{x:linear[0],y:linear[1],z:linear[2]}:null},
                    accelerationIncludingGravity:{value:{x:gravity[0]+linear[0],y:gravity[1]+linear[1],z:gravity[2]+linear[2]}},
                    rotationRate:{value:{alpha:rotation,beta:0,gamma:0}},interval:{value:20}
                });
                window.dispatchEvent(event);
            };
        });
        const start=async()=>{await page.click('[onclick="requestStartTrip()"]');await page.waitForFunction(()=>tripActive);};
        await start();
        const geometry=await page.evaluate(()=>{
            const counts=[];
            for(const up of [[0,0,1],[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0.6,0.8,0]]) {
                const g=up.map(value=>value*9.81);
                for(let i=0;i<70;i++) __motion(g);
                const before=liveBumpsCount;
                for(let i=0;i<5;i++) __motion(g,up.map(value=>value*5));
                const point=telemetryStream.at(-1);
                counts.push({difference:liveBumpsCount-before,horizontal:Math.hypot(point.ax,point.ay),vertical:point.az-9.81});
                for(let i=0;i<70;i++) __motion(g);
            }
            const beforeRotation=liveBumpsCount;
            for(let i=0;i<100;i++) {
                const angle=i*Math.PI/100;
                __motion([0,9.81*Math.sin(angle),9.81*Math.cos(angle)],[0,0,0],90);
            }
            // Gravity-inclusive devices must also work in portrait orientation.
            for(let i=0;i<80;i++) __motion([0,9.81,0],[0,0,0],0,false);
            const beforeFallback=liveBumpsCount;
            for(let i=0;i<5;i++) __motion([0,9.81,0],[0,5,0],0,false);
            return {counts,beforeRotation,afterRotation:beforeFallback,fallback:liveBumpsCount-beforeFallback};
        });
        assert(geometry.counts.every(value=>value.difference===0));
        assert(geometry.counts.every(value=>value.horizontal<0.001 && Math.abs(value.vertical-5)<0.001));
        assert.equal(geometry.afterRotation,geometry.beforeRotation);
        assert.equal(geometry.fallback,0);
        assert.equal(await page.locator('#trip-live-savings').innerText(),'+0.00 ₽');
        await page.evaluate(()=>finishActiveTrip());
        assert.equal(await page.locator('#sum-bumps').innerText(),'0');
        assert.equal(await page.locator('#sum-savings-rub').innerText(),'+0.00 ₽');
        assert.equal(await page.locator('#sum-offline-banner').evaluate(el=>el.classList.contains('visible')),false);
        await page.evaluate(()=>claimToPiggyBank());

        const before=(await (await page.request.get(`${base}/api/v1/users/${owner}/dashboard`,{headers})).json());
        await start();
        await page.evaluate(()=>{
            __gps(10);
            for(let i=0;i<1000;i++) {
                __motion([0,9.81,0]);
                if((i+1)%50===0) __gps(10);
            }
        });
        const previewResponse=page.waitForResponse('**/api/v1/telemetry/preview');
        await page.evaluate(()=>updateLiveEstimate());
        const preview=await (await previewResponse).json();
        assert(preview.cost_savings_rub>0);
        assert.equal(preview.math_status.monetary_credit_status,'model_estimate');
        assert.match(await page.locator('#trip-live-savings').innerText(),/^\+[0-9]+\.[0-9]{2} ₽$/);
        assert.deepEqual(await (await page.request.get(`${base}/api/v1/users/${owner}/dashboard`,{headers})).json(),before);
        await page.evaluate(()=>finishActiveTrip());
        assert(Number((await page.locator('#sum-savings-rub').innerText()).replace(/[+ ₽]/g,''))>0);
        const after=await (await page.request.get(`${base}/api/v1/users/${owner}/dashboard`,{headers})).json();
        assert.equal(after.total_trips,before.total_trips+1);

        // A response for a finished recording must not update the next trip.
        await page.evaluate(()=>claimToPiggyBank());
        await start();
        await page.evaluate(()=>{__gps(10);for(let i=0;i<100;i++) __motion([0,9.81,0]);});
        let releaseOldPreview;
        const heldPreview=new Promise(resolve=>{releaseOldPreview=resolve;});
        await page.route('**/api/v1/telemetry/preview',async route=>{
            const payload=route.request().postDataJSON();
            await heldPreview;
            await route.fulfill({status:200,contentType:'application/json',body:JSON.stringify({
                session_id:payload.session_id,status:'PREVIEW',cost_savings_rub:999
            })}).catch(()=>{});
        });
        const requested=page.waitForRequest('**/api/v1/telemetry/preview');
        await page.evaluate(()=>{window.__oldPreview=updateLiveEstimate();});
        await requested;
        await page.evaluate(()=>finishActiveTrip());
        await page.evaluate(()=>claimToPiggyBank());
        await start();
        releaseOldPreview();
        await page.evaluate(()=>window.__oldPreview);
        assert.equal(await page.locator('#trip-live-savings').innerText(),'+0.00 ₽');
        await page.unroute('**/api/v1/telemetry/preview');
        await page.evaluate(()=>finishActiveTrip());

        // Long recordings retain their raw samples while bounding preview uploads.
        await page.evaluate(()=>claimToPiggyBank());
        await start();
        await page.evaluate(()=>{
            __gps(10);
            for(let i=0;i<6500;i++) {__motion([0,9.81,0]);if((i+1)%50===0) __gps(10);}
        });
        const bounded=page.waitForRequest('**/api/v1/telemetry/preview');
        await page.evaluate(()=>updateLiveEstimate());
        const sampled=(await bounded).postDataJSON();
        assert(sampled.telemetry_stream.length<=6000);
        assert(sampled.sampling_stride>1);
        assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>telemetryStream.length),6500);
        assert.equal(sampled.telemetry_stream.at(-1).t,await page.evaluate(()=>telemetryStream.at(-1).t));
        await page.evaluate(()=>finishActiveTrip());
        assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);
        console.log('Live metrics: stationary speed veto, gravity projection, rotation veto, moving financial preview, stale replies and full long-capture retention passed');
        await context.close();
    } finally {await browser.close();}
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exit(1);});
````

````javascript
        const id=await page.evaluate(async()=>{
            const now=Date.now(), id=crypto.randomUUID();
            const body={session_id:id,user_id:AutoXAKSession.getUserId(),car_id:currentCarId,
                telemetry_stream:[],raw_recording:{started_at_ms:now-1000,ended_at_ms:now,gps:[],motion:[]}};
            await AutoXAKOfflineStore.savePendingTrip(body);
            await AutoXAKOfflineStore.saveDraftTrip(body);
            return id;
        });
        assert((await page.evaluate(()=>AutoXAKOfflineStore.getPendingTrips())).some(trip=>trip.session_id===id));

        // History must recover a durable trip even without the optional localStorage list.
        await page.route('**/api/v1/telemetry/session',route=>route.fulfill({status:503,body:'unavailable'}));
        await page.goto(base+'/history');
        await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('pending-status').textContent.includes('1'));
        assert.equal(await page.evaluate(id=>loadedTrips.some(trip=>trip.session_id===id),id),false);
        await page.unroute('**/api/v1/telemetry/session');
        await page.evaluate(()=>AutoXAKOfflineStore.syncPendingTrips());
        await page.evaluate(()=>fetchHistory());
        assert.equal(await page.evaluate(id=>loadedTrips.filter(trip=>trip.session_id===id).length,id),1);
        await context.setOffline(true);
        await page.evaluate(()=>fetchHistory());
        assert.equal(await page.evaluate(id=>loadedTrips.filter(trip=>trip.session_id===id).length,id),1);
        await context.setOffline(false);

        // Editing a control while its old value is in flight preserves the new revision.
        await page.evaluate(async id=>{
            await AutoXAKOfflineStore.savePendingControl(id,8);
            const original=window.fetch;
            window.__controlValues=[];
            window.fetch=async (url,options)=>{
                if(String(url).includes('/board-computer')) {
                    __controlValues.push(JSON.parse(options.body).board_computer_consumption_l100km);
                    if(__controlValues.length===1) await new Promise(resolve=>{window.__releaseControl=resolve;});
                }
                return original(url,options);
            };
            window.__controlSync=AutoXAKOfflineStore.syncPendingTrips();
        },id);
        await page.waitForFunction(()=>!!window.__releaseControl);
        await page.evaluate(async id=>{
            await AutoXAKOfflineStore.savePendingControl(id,9);
            __releaseControl();
            await __controlSync;
            await AutoXAKOfflineStore.syncPendingTrips();
        },id);
        assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(()=>__controlValues),[8,9]);

        // All pages use one fixed end time and explicit all-time history.
        const ends=[];
        await page.route('**/analytics/period?*',async route=>{
            const params=new URL(route.request().url()).searchParams;
            assert.equal(params.get('all_time'),'true');
            ends.push(params.get('end_date'));
            const offset=Number(params.get('offset'));
            const trips=Array.from({length:offset===0?200:1},(_,i)=>({session_id:'paged-'+(offset+i),created_at:'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',total_savings_rub:1}));
            await route.fulfill({json:{summary:{total_trips:201,total_savings_rub:201},trips}});
        });
        await page.evaluate(()=>fetchHistory());
        assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>loadedTrips.filter(trip=>trip.session_id.startsWith('paged-')).length),201);
        assert.equal(new Set(ends).size,1);
        await page.unroute('**/analytics/period?*');

        await page.goto(base+'/');
        await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');
        const stale=await page.evaluate(async()=>{
            window.__fixes=[];
            Object.defineProperty(navigator,'geolocation',{configurable:true,value:{watchPosition(callback){__fixes.push(callback);return __fixes.length;},clearWatch(){}}});
            await beginActiveTrip();
            const originalOwner=recordingOwnerId,originalCar=recordingCarId;
            currentCarId='changed-during-recording';
            await saveActiveDraft();
            await finishActiveTrip();
            const id=lastFinishedSessionId;
            document.getElementById('summary-modal').classList.remove('active');
            await beginActiveTrip();
            __fixes[0]({timestamp:Date.now(),coords:{latitude:55.75,longitude:37.61,accuracy:5,speed:10}});
            const count=gpsSamples.length;
            await finishActiveTrip();
            return {id,count,originalOwner,originalCar};
        });
        assert.equal(stale.count,0);
        const saved=await page.request.get(`${base}/api/v2/trips/${stale.id}/export`,{headers:identity.headers});
        assert.equal((await saved.json()).vehicle.vehicle_id,stale.originalCar);
        assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);
        console.log('Browser: fuel price preservation, remote garage update, response-body deadline, finalized draft, durable/offline history, control revision, pagination, stale GPS/session snapshot passed');
        await context.close();
    } finally {await browser.close();}
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exit(1);});
````

````javascript
(async()=>{
    const browser = await chromium.launch({executablePath:process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH || '/usr/bin/chromium',headless:true,args:['--no-sandbox']});
    try {
        const context = await browser.newContext();
        await context.addInitScript(()=>{
            window.__alerts=[];
            window.alert=message=>window.__alerts.push(message);
        });
        const page = await context.newPage();
        const errors=[];
        page.on('pageerror',error=>errors.push(error.message));
        await page.goto(base+'/login');

        const identity=await page.evaluate(()=>({user:AutoXAKSession.getUserId(),headers:AutoXAKSession.getAuthHeaders()}));

        async function installSensors(permission='granted') {
            await page.evaluate(permission=>{
                let clock=Date.now(),fix,error,meters=0;
                window.__sensorStats={permissionCalls:0,watches:0,initialPositionCalls:0,cleared:[]};
                Date.now=()=>clock;

                    if(!navigator.userActivation.isActive) return Promise.reject(new Error('No user gesture'));
                    __sensorStats.permissionCalls++;

                    getCurrentPosition:()=>{__sensorStats.initialPositionCalls++;throw new Error('Duplicate permission request');},
                    watchPosition:(callback,onError)=>{fix=callback;error=onError;return __sensorStats.watches++;},
                    clearWatch:id=>__sensorStats.cleared.push(id)
                }});

                window.__gpsError=()=>error({code:1});

                    for(let i=0;i<count;i++) {
                        clock+=20;
                        const event=new Event('devicemotion');
                        Object.defineProperties(event,{acceleration:{value:null},accelerationIncludingGravity:{value:{x:0.1,y:0,z:9.81}},
                            rotationRate:{value:{alpha:3,beta:1,gamma:2}},interval:{value:20}});

            const id=await page.evaluate(()=>lastFinishedSessionId);
            const response=await page.request.get(`${base}/api/v2/trips/${id}/export`,{headers:identity.headers});
            assert.equal(response.status(),200,await response.text());

        const notRecoveredWhileActive=await page.evaluate(async()=>{

        assert.equal(limitedData.ended_at_ms-limitedData.started_at_ms,86400000);

        const queuePair=await page.evaluate(async()=>{
            const good=crypto.randomUUID(),bad='!!!rejected-'+crypto.randomUUID(),now=Math.round(performance.timeOrigin+performance.now());
            const payload={user_id:AutoXAKSession.getUserId(),car_id:currentCarId,telemetry_stream:[],
                raw_recording:{started_at_ms:now,ended_at_ms:now,gps:[],motion:[]}};
            await AutoXAKOfflineStore.savePendingTrip({...payload,session_id:bad});
            await AutoXAKOfflineStore.savePendingTrip({...payload,session_id:good});
            return {good,bad};
        });
        await page.route('**/api/v1/telemetry/session',route=>{
            if(route.request().postDataJSON().session_id===queuePair.bad) return route.fulfill({status:422,contentType:'application/json',body:'{}'});
            return route.continue();
        });
        await page.evaluate(()=>AutoXAKOfflineStore.syncPendingTrips());
        assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(async()=>(await AutoXAKOfflineStore.getPendingTrips()).map(item=>item.session_id)),[queuePair.bad]);
        await page.unroute('**/api/v1/telemetry/session');
        await page.evaluate(id=>AutoXAKOfflineStore.removePendingTrip(id),queuePair.bad);

        const history=await page.request.get(`${base}/api/v1/users/${identity.user}/analytics/period`,{headers:identity.headers});
        assert.equal((await history.json()).trips.length,8);
        assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);
        console.log('Recording: iOS gesture, one GPS watch, independent IMU, weak GPS, denied motion, GPS-only history, offline retry and failed-save recovery passed');
        await context.close();
    } finally {await browser.close();}
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exit(1);});
````

````javascript
// Exercise transport failure paths, including a body that stalls after headers.
const vm = require('node:vm');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');

(async()=>{
    const handlers={}, entries=new Map(), buckets=new Map();
    const bucket={match:async key=>entries.get(key)?.clone(),put:async(key,value)=>entries.set(key,value.clone())};
    buckets.set('autoxak-shell-v6',bucket);
    buckets.set('autoxak-shell-v2',{});
    buckets.set('unrelated-app',{});
    let request;
    const sandbox={URL,Response,Headers,AbortController,console,clearTimeout,
        setTimeout:callback=>setTimeout(callback,25),
        fetch:(...args)=>request(...args),
        caches:{open:async()=>bucket,keys:async()=>[...buckets.keys()],delete:async key=>buckets.delete(key)},
        self:{location:{origin:'https://autoxak.example'},clients:{claim:async()=>{}},addEventListener:(name,handler)=>{handlers[name]=handler;}}};
    vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'../../static/sw.js'),'utf8'),sandbox);
    async function load(url='https://autoxak.example/?probe=1',method='GET') {
        let result;
        handlers.fetch({request:{url,method},respondWith:promise=>{result=promise;}});
        return result;
    }
    entries.set('/',new Response('cached shell'));
    request=async()=>new Response('fresh shell');
    assert.equal(await (await load()).text(),'fresh shell');
    assert.equal(await (await bucket.match('/')).text(),'fresh shell');
    assert.equal(entries.size,1);
    request=async()=>new Response('decoded shell',{headers:{'Content-Encoding':'gzip','Content-Length':'4'}});
    const decoded=await load();
    assert.equal(await decoded.text(),'decoded shell');
    assert.equal(decoded.headers.get('content-encoding'),null);
    assert.equal(decoded.headers.get('content-length'),null);
    entries.set('/',new Response('fresh shell'));
    request=async()=>{throw new Error('Offline');};
    assert.equal(await (await load()).text(),'fresh shell');
    request=async()=>new Response('unavailable',{status:503});
    assert.equal(await (await load()).text(),'fresh shell');
    request=async()=>({ok:true,redirected:true});
    assert.equal(await (await load()).text(),'fresh shell');
    request=(url,{signal})=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>signal.addEventListener('abort',()=>reject(new Error('Timeout'))));
    assert.equal(await (await load()).text(),'fresh shell');
    request=async(url,{signal})=>new Response(new ReadableStream({start(controller){
        signal.addEventListener('abort',()=>controller.error(new Error('Body timeout')));
    }}));
    assert.equal(await (await load()).text(),'fresh shell');
    assert.equal(await (await bucket.match('/')).text(),'fresh shell');
    request=async()=>{throw new Error('Offline');};
    assert.equal((await load('https://autoxak.example/setup')).status,0);
    assert.equal(await load('https://autoxak.example/api/v1/auth/me'),undefined);
    assert.equal(await load('https://another.example/'),undefined);
    assert.equal(await load(undefined,'POST'),undefined);
    let activation;
    handlers.activate({waitUntil:promise=>{activation=promise;}});
    await activation;
    assert(buckets.has('autoxak-shell-v6') && buckets.has('unrelated-app') && !buckets.has('autoxak-shell-v2'));
    console.log('Service worker: fresh/cached shell, 503, redirected login, stalled headers/body, query canonicalization, API bypass, cache upgrade passed');
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exit(1);});
````

### 7.43. `tests/test_audit_regressions.py`

Ожидания нового серверного денежного результата и нулевой стоянки вместо прежнего отсутствия расчёта.

- Статус: `M`. Размер итогового файла: 20519 байт.
- SHA-256 после: `7644ea8a4a7ad0389dc4c5fa859642fa6452acafde57701bc5f9d0dc43f402f4`.
- SHA-256 до: `a48d0c4c7d3c87e8911dc0f8ed1d78155d2aef1773ecbb34583b15e616246e96`.

````python
"""Regressions for authentication, durable writes, boundaries, and model evidence."""
import asyncio
import base64
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import uuid

import numpy as np
import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError

from app.core.security import SECRET_KEY, create_access_token, decode_access_token
from app.core.dsp.filters import SignalFilter
from app.core.dsp.simplifier import PathSimplifier
from app.models.telemetry import TripSessionPayload
from app.schemas.vehicle import CustomVehicleInput
from app.services.benchmark_engine import BenchmarkEngine
from app.services.twin_engine import TwinEngine
from app.services.profile_synthesizer import ProfileSynthesizer


def signed(claims, algorithm='HS256'):
    encode = lambda obj: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(obj).encode()).decode().rstrip('=')
    content = encode({'alg': algorithm, 'typ': 'JWT'}) + '.' + encode(claims)
    signature = hmac.new(SECRET_KEY.encode(), content.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    return content + '.' + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(signature).decode().rstrip('=')


@pytest.mark.parametrize('claims', [[], {}, {'sub': 'u'}, {'sub': 'u', 'exp': False},
    {'sub': 'u', 'exp': 0}, {'sub': 'u', 'exp': float('nan')}, {'sub': [], 'exp': 99999999999}])
def test_invalid_signed_claims_are_rejected(claims):
    assert decode_access_token(signed(claims)) is None


def test_reserved_claims_and_zero_expiry_cannot_extend_session():
    token = create_access_token('owner', {'sub': 'attacker', 'exp': 999999999999})
    assert decode_access_token(token)['sub'] == 'owner'
    assert decode_access_token(token)['exp'] < 999999999999
    assert decode_access_token(create_access_token('owner', expires_delta=timedelta(0))) is None
````
